Peter,

Unlike Joe Biden, the American People can’t turn a blind eye to the border crisis. That’s why the GOP is putting together a task force letter urging Biden to acknowledge his FAILURES, and we need YOU to co-sign our letter and help amplify the message.

Sincerely,

An American Citizen _**

**SEPTEMBER MONTH-END****GRASSROOTS UPDATE** Here’s what you need to know and just a few of the ways you can get involved:
* * *
**SENATOR LISA MURKOWSKI** Out of the seven Republican Senators who voted to convict former President Trump, [U.S. Senator Lisa Murkowski](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=FBc-Q4-JoNGb1vhsLBVQHIll6kksO0ixg4vrMBykWy4&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=innovate_post_nd&n=3) is the only one up for reelection in 2022\. Senator Murkowski has proven that she is more than willing to put country over party regardless of the election cycle. For this reason, **Country First is proud to endorse Senator Murkowski and invites all members to participate in virtual tele-outreach efforts.** When you sign up, you will be contacted by a volunteer coordinator who will provide you with the necessary resources and guidance to contact Alaskans and encourage them to support Senator Murkowski. Sign up below: | [](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=KFozupC4hMau3PknCEub8uGw0BqMl9_HNlbOKaZMhThG2ywkelOec0tzvwA4FA9t&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=innovate_post_nd&n=4 "Sign Up to Volunteer for Sen. Murkowski") [Sign Up to Volunteer for Sen. Murkowski](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=KFozupC4hMau3PknCEub8uGw0BqMl9_HNlbOKaZMhThG2ywkelOec0tzvwA4FA9t&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=innovate_post_nd&n=4)
---
* * *
**NEW VOLUNTEER TRAINING - NEXT TUESDAY**
On the last Tuesday of each month, we come together to welcome our thousands of new members and volunteers by hosting a training to go over all things Country First. This training provides a comprehensive overview of our Grassroots Program and provides an opportunity to engage in dialogue with other members from across the country. **The next training will be held on Tuesday, September 27, 2022 at 5:00pm PST / 6:00pm MST / 7:00pm CST / 8:00pm** **EST.** New members, sign up below:
[](https://www.country1st.com/vol092022?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=innovate_post_nd&n=5 "Attend New Volunteer Training") [Attend New Volunteer Training](https://www.country1st.com/vol092022?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=innovate_post_nd&n=5)
---
* * *
**STATE ORGANIZER TRAINING - NEXT WEDNESDAY**
On the last Wednesday of each month, state organizers from all across the United States convene to discuss ways to expand the Country First movement. Country First State Organizers remain committed to elevating their skills to empower members in each state to take action and join the conversation. **The next training will be held on Wednesday, September 28, 2022 at 5:00pm PST / 6:00pm MST / 7:00pm CST / 8:00pm** **EST.** Join our national community of state organizers by signing up below:
[](https://www.country1st.com/soc_092022?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=innovate_post_nd&n=6 "Attend State Organizer Training") [Attend State Organizer Training](https://www.country1st.com/soc_092022?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=innovate_post_nd&n=6)
---
* * *
**MENDING DIVISIONS - NEXT THURSDAY**
Too many people have broken relationships with their neighbors, colleagues, friends, and even family members over our toxic political system. Our conversations have turned into accusations, name-calling, and defensiveness rather than active listening, learning from one another’s perspectives, and coming together to strengthen American democracy. Country First is dedicated to turning down the temperature in our conversations and building common ground.
This volunteer-led committee will be hosting a series of training sessions to equip Country First members with the necessary tools to better dialogue in their own community, workplace, home, and beyond. Additionally, committee members will have the opportunity to sign up to lead during our National Virtual Campfires. **The next Mending Divisions training will be held on Thursday, September 29 at 5:00pm PST / 6:00pm MST / 7:00pm CST / 8:00pm EST.** Change agents, sign up below:
[](https://www.country1st.com/md092022_3?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=innovate_post_nd&n=7 "Attend Mending Divisions Training") [Attend Mending Divisions Training](https://www.country1st.com/md092022_3?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=innovate_post_nd&n=7)
---
* * *
**BOOK CLUB - NEXT THURSDAY**
The Country First Book Club gathers each month to read a book and discuss the very problems that Country First aims to address. This month’s book is **[_Them: Why We Hate Each Other -- and How to Heal_ by Ben Sasse](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=heodq3ohBAOIdlJZg-UqpFB3_Nes-Mt7uBYerKlhGWDTtTn9EnZGd3YQKelSphZazQgqy52nkkt1Q4N-9ILZ0w&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=innovate_post_nd&n=8)**. **The next Book Club meeting will be held on Thursday, September 29 at 4:00pm PST / 5:00pm MST / 6:00pm CST / 7:00pm EST.** Book Lovers, RSVP below:

---
* * *
**YOU+TWO**
The Country First movement continues to expand across the nation like wildfire. Each month, we have seen larger audiences at state chapter meetings, national training sessions, virtual campfires, and on our online communities. Introducing someone from your network or community to this empowering movement is one of the biggest differences you could make. It is critical for all of us to work together to share the Country First message far and wide and get others to join in on our mission.
From here on out, we encourage you to bring at least two others to any program you attend and to forward our emails to at least two others. You can start by sharing this email, or log on to the action center to see what's happening throughout the movement and utilize your unique recruiter link.
Your unique recruiter link to share:
https://www.country1st.com/opportunity?recruiter_id=91510

We strongly encourage you to join the conversation by signing up for our [Private Troll-Free Facebook Group](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=27Ax0UmWOX2J8J_QwK9Z6sAbiimTwRd6ssr23ZzK-qLNKlsAAN6GQt_CjSeXswXh&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=innovate_post_nd&n=10) or our [Private Slack Community](https://www.country1st.com/slack?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=innovate_post_nd&n=11). ---
Make no mistake... My opponent would be a NIGHTMARE to the pro-freedom, pro-America agenda we want to implement. Here's what you should know about Katie Hobbs. -> **_SHE WILL NOT DEFEND YOUR RIGHT TO BEAR ARMS!_** Katie has an F grade when it comes to protecting our Second Amendment rights. I don't know about you, but I feel that our Second Amendment is the most important amendment right now. _It 's the reason that we are still free. _**_-> HER VOTING RECORD IS SHOCKING! _**She'll never talk about it, but 90% of the time when she was in our state legislature, she voted against small businesses. 90 percent!**_-> SHE FAILED TO SECURE OUR ELECTIONS._** Hobbs served as Secretary of State in 2020 in one of the most corrupt elections in American history. **_-> SHE IS A CONVICTED RACIST! _**Two separate juries unanimously convicted her of racial discrimination, and the taxpayers of Arizona are paying for her crimes! Almost $3 million as a payout for her court settlement because she did not pay Black employees the same as she paid white employees. _That is disgusting._
We cannot afford to let a radical lefty like Katie Hobbs turn Arizona into another California.**__**_[**Will you help me defeat her?**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61373379:6H0cTaVJN:m:1:3334294963:769FCF2334560D5EBD6C5F0ECD74E494:r)_
---
Now, I don't care if you're with the Democrat Party, the Independent Party, the Republican Party, the Pizza Party, or the Pool Party - our policies are going to help every American. **_[We have to stand together and defeat the left so we can save America](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61373379:6H0cTaVJN:m:1:3334294963:769FCF2334560D5EBD6C5F0ECD74E494:r)_. ** I hope that you will chip in now to support my campaign for Governor of Arizona.**__**

name: Herschel Walker
subject: The time is now, Peter
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Stand for America PAC
body:
| |
---
| | |
Peter,

I don't have good news today...

**Recent polling shows my Democrat opponent, Raphael Warnock, leading by 3 points.** For months we've been in a dead heat, but now I'm slightly behind in Georgia's crucial Senate showdown.

This is a significant setback for Republicans everywhere.

I wish that was the only piece of bad news I had for you today, but it's not...

My Democrat opponent is the _leading _fundraiser in the entire country. He's raising record amounts of money in record time. The latest report shows he raised $17 MILLION in the last 3 MONTHS. If I'm going to catch up, I need MAJOR reinforcements, which is why I'm reaching out to you today, Peter. _**[I need you to rush an emergency contribution of ANY AMOUNT to help us close the fundraising gap.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61380906:6kr-6aVXN:m:1:3253819041:963FE8E89C26B6B1127230C3E19E51D0:r "It’s important that we band
together and show the Democrats that we’re willing to do whatever it takes to pull off a win.")**_

There's too much at stake to sit on the sidelines. _Georgia is in danger. Our Senate majority is in danger. The future of our country is in danger._

Democrat Super PACs and my opponent have already spent $25 million in false attack ads against me, which is why we've lost ground in the polls. _Unfortunately, we haven't had the money to respond or set the record straight._

This is just the beginning... Democrats are already scheming on how to spend another $25 MILLION. _**[They MUST be STOPPED.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61380906:6kr-6aVXN:m:1:3253819041:963FE8E89C26B6B1127230C3E19E51D0:r "It’s

Peter,

I don't have good news today...

**Recent polling shows my Democrat opponent, Raphael Warnock, leading by 3 points.** For months we've been in a dead heat, but now I'm slightly behind in Georgia's crucial Senate showdown.

This is a significant setback for Republicans everywhere.

I wish that was the only piece of bad news I had for you today, but it's not...

My Democrat opponent is the _leading _fundraiser in the entire country. He's raising record amounts of money in record time. The latest report shows he raised $17 MILLION in the last 3 MONTHS. together and show the Democrats that we’re willing to do whatever it takes to pull off a win.")**_

There's too much at stake to sit on the sidelines. _Georgia is in danger. Our Senate majority is in danger. The future of our country is in danger._

Democrat Super PACs and my opponent have already spent $25 million in false attack ads against me, which is why we've lost ground in the polls. _Unfortunately, we haven't had the money to respond or set the record straight._

This is just the beginning... Democrats are already scheming on how to spend another $25 MILLION. _**[They MUST be STOPPED.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61380915:JGITpaVON:m:1:3317145305:F5A6874C9D0132A4BAFA80D64C9510C0:r "It’s
important that we band together and show the Democrats that we’re willing to do whatever it takes to pull off a win.")**_

It's clear that they see me as a threat. The fate of the Senate majority will be determined by the outcome of our race in Georgia. That's why we must fully fund our ads and grassroots efforts to make sure Georgians learn the truth about Raphael Warnock's far-left record.

_**[Peter, I need your help now more than ever. If you're able, would you please contribute $10 or more to help us close the fundraising gap? Every penny counts, and your help is CRITICAL.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61380915:JGITpaVON:m:1:3317145305:F5A6874C9D0132A4BAFA80D64C9510C0:r "It’s important that we band together and show the Democrats that we’re willing to do whatever it
takes to pull off a win.")**_

Thank you for your support.

Onward to victory,

Herschel Walker
Republican for U.S. Senate

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: It's time to make change
body:
In 1973, the U.S. Supreme Court decided the case Roe v. Wade. And since that day, more than 63 million babies have been killed through abortion in our country. [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c920805%7c6098%7c7%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c0&wdmdk=E%2bwX0DRsysqAH9J5BaXdww&sysid=1)

| | From the Desk of Dr. Ben Carson: Hello, In 1973, the U.S. Supreme Court decided the case Roe v. Wade. And since that day, more than 63 million babies have been killed through abortion in our country. It was the most destructive ruling in the history of our nation. And it led to an anti-life ideology that still infects America to this day. From what I’ve been told, you are someone who values and respects life in all its stages, and I’m guessing this makes you sick to your stomach just like it does to me. But the tide is changing, and that’s why I asked if I could send you this email today. [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86613%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=s6oiC8LKkHLt%2bIBTT7WHkQ&sysid=1)[](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86614%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=K7feMEUDSgLiv5sksBThmQ&sysid=1)
_Dr. Ben Carson, Founder and Chairman of American Cornerstone Institute_ The U.S. Supreme Court’s decision to overturn Roe gives us a historic opportunity to rebuild a culture of life. The battle for life has returned to the states. And we have a lot of work to do. Because the laws and needs of each state vary, it will take a supercharged effort to fight for the protection of the unborn. But the American Cornerstone Institute is committed to providing resources to support pro-life efforts in each state. And that’s why we need YOU! **Will you help rebuild a culture of life in states across America by making a tax-deductible gift today?** We have seen that the opposition is more hostile than ever now that the official decision has come down. We got a glimpse at those who are anti-life have reacted since the leak was made public. That’s why we’re asking you to give right now to help us fight back to protect life for the unborn with every tool at our disposal. So, please don’t wait. You can make your tax-deductible gift to protect life in states across America using this secure link: **[https://secure.americancornerstone.org/pro-life-states-confirmation](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86625%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=41jSOGfO%2fbbCnCJYKbeB%2fg&sysid=1)** Thank you so much for any support you can offer. Regards,
Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman
American Cornerstone Institute

I developed that backbone of steel - that "BDE" that President Trump and Governor Ron DeSantis have. And frankly, that we want all of our elected leaders to have. Someone even recently told me "Kari, you're going to be the DeSantis of the West." Other than being called "Trump in a Dress" -- which is my favorite compliment of all -- that is the greatest compliment you could pay me. **To me, that means that you know when you elect me, you 're going to get someone who fights for you every single day. ** We are going to be so effective in Arizona.
---
[**SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61381380:6lZUmaVNw:m:1:3331421248:F8376390C67B993EE70E55FD505E6990:r)

**Peter, I promise you this, as the governor of Arizona, I will be the biggest pain in the ass Joe Biden 's ever experienced. ** I will unite with conservatives across the country to protect Arizona from this out-of-control federal government. We will save our states and return the power to WE, THE PEOPLE, where it belongs. **_This is our moment to make it happen. _**

Make no mistake... My opponent would be a NIGHTMARE to the pro-freedom, pro-America agenda we want to implement. Here's what you should know about Katie Hobbs. ➡️ **_SHE WILL NOT DEFEND YOUR RIGHT TO BEAR ARMS!_** Katie has an F grade when it comes to protecting our Second Amendment rights. I don't know about you, but I feel that our Second Amendment is the most important amendment right now. _It 's the reason that we are still free. _ **➡️ _HER VOTING RECORD IS SHOCKING!_** She'll never talk about it, but 90% of the time when she was in our state legislature, she voted against small businesses. 90 percent! **➡️ _SHE FAILED TO SECURE OUR ELECTIONS._** Hobbs served as Secretary of State in 2020 in one of the most corrupt elections in American history. **➡️ _SHE IS A CONVICTED RACIST!_** Two separate juries unanimously convicted her of racial discrimination, and the taxpayers of Arizona are paying for her crimes! Almost $3 million as a payout for her court settlement because she did not pay Black employees the same as she paid white employees. _That is disgusting._
We cannot afford to let a radical lefty like Katie Hobbs turn Arizona into another California.**__**_[**Will you help me defeat her?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61381380:6lZUmaVNw:m:1:3331421248:F8376390C67B993EE70E55FD505E6990:r)_
---
Now, I don't care if you're with the Democrat Party, the Independent Party, the Republican Party, the Pizza Party, or the Pool Party - our policies are going to help every American. **_[We have to stand together and defeat the left so we can save America](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61381380:6lZUmaVNw:m:1:3331421248:F8376390C67B993EE70E55FD505E6990:r)_. ** I hope that you will chip in now to support my campaign for Governor of Arizona.**__**
---

body:
I wanted to share these special moments with you.
[View this message in your browser](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zpcfpf8r6srkp9a8f483bpsr4p8jo9vkbg45ppfg_rp22sh2s8i66or1c1i6epj0cph238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuij791lmkp79dhk6eojacpl6er7actl6tr779hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onkmgp70sbiedpm4pbmemq6dchgmcon6s9mm4r73dtkm9ge0tr56epjatj2cmon1puie1p68dhgm9j74t1hepge1d3563gbacb4spj6cc9n6mo60tj7coo7ecr66uobapbi4no)

| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zgiou5jjg6522mg8q3cs78kdhbie1h560csjrar0_rp22sh2s8i66or1c1i6epj0cph2bs "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zjal5pavv7tb31rke3e8ba6pfhc6aqnl7s3ifulo_rp22sh2s8i66or1c1i6epj0cph2bs "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zvljikemqncpiuhm0f32gqpujq27tos6g61sopk8_rp22sh2s8i66or1c1i6epj0cph2bs "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z8bn2ld18ctrc082kcb99stsa5fbb50l5dij8398_rp22sh2s8i66or1c1i6epj0cph2bs "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zvr8dqn0li5sjpeklddghbnurmhfsgm9md65qqkg_rp22sh2s8i66or1c1i6epj0cph2bs "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zgius3imadeelnu1jrtqiq96t0odmfo8h16la69o_rp22sh2s8i66or1c1i6epj0cph2bs "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zdkt8h6o61o5gtqpc72hh508rc4a43sfabvk6euo_rp22sh2s8i66or1c1i6epj0cph2bs "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z6ci9nfusstfdn7tg50c9nra5m6hqos5afuf4d4o_rp22sh2s8i66or1c1i6epj0cph2bs "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z35n95sglmnr28fu0ijk90l8adpus9an55cv68k0_rp22sh2s8i66or1c1i6epj0cph2bs "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zf4eesesa5vd0f17eag0v9pf9opnjhpb99d7f6l8_rp22sh2s8i66or1c1i6epj0cph2bs "So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far.")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zod2du7jq4kobhp8tg0h6puupdfhbrpd18h7lb0g_rp22sh2s8i66or1c1i6epj0cph2bs "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zshfjt225ralk00u486s8n5dskmi7445ef5cm7ro_rp22sh2s8i66or1c1i6epj0cph2bs "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---

---

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z67e205oghm7ktopk2kv1999cds9ue8f9hc77a7g_rp22sh2s8i66or1c1i6epj0cph2bs "All Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zkc51gmhk9o4jebrafqktouc9bs4u444jgknh2sg_rp22sh2s8i66or1c1i6epj0cph2bs "Rush support now to be a part of history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM SMILEY](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zailspm2kb7lpqojk3pf904j606sftckblqgn3bo_rp22sh2s8i66or1c1i6epj0cph2bs "JOIN TEAM SMILEY")
---

---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zbcgudb0eatkd073bfsfvgm8u6nbj557oh767s08_rp22sh2s8i66or1c1i6epj0cph2bs "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zh0ig0aa29aem6jso908eq7ngikuel2l795klpmo_rp22sh2s8i66or1c1i6epj0cph2bs "Step up now!")**_

body:

Folks, we’ve got to stay focused.
By now, I’m sure you’ve read all about DeSantis’s latest political stunts. Gov. DeSantis lied to refugee families, trafficked them across state lines, and then left them in Martha’s Vineyard.
He even attempted to fly another group of migrants to Delaware but instead left them stranded in Texas in an attempt to “punk” the media.

name: John Gomez  - Campaign Manager
subject: Chabot for Congress - Update from the Campaign Trail 9/23
body:
New Ad, Important Press Release, and Events Throughout OH-01!
No images? [Click here](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-e-tjpltky-kujkulhluu-v/) [](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjpltky-kujkulhluu-r/)
# Update from the Campaign Trail 9/23/22
Good evening,Team Chabot continues to work hard across the district. This week comes with several important updates. The campaign released its second ad, titled "Can't Afford", on Wednesday. The campaign also published a release detailing how Greg Landsman's Pelosi-inspired agenda has contributed to record-shattering rent increases in Cincinnati. We also have updates on many of the events that Congressman Chabot has attended across the district in the last week!Read on for these updates and more from the trail! **_Congressman Chabot on the Trail_** _Congressman Chabot and Team Knocking Doors_ Congressman Chabot continues to bring his message directly to voters' doors. This week Congressman Chabot knocked doors in St. Bernard and other parts of the district. Responses have been incredibly positive on the ground. Momentum is on our side as we enter the home stretch of the campaign! _Reading Septemberfest_ This past weekend, Congressman Chabot attending Septemberfest hosted by Our Lady of the Valley in Reading. Congressman Chabot was born in a trailer park in Reading and spent the first few years of his life there. He's always thankful to return to this fantastic community. _Moeller at St. X Football Game_ There's nothing quite like Friday night lights in Cincinnati. Congressman Chabot attended the Moeller at St. X football game last Friday and greeted folks as the entered the game. Folks were excited about the game and making sure that we get our country back on track this fall. **_St. Bernard Police Benevolent Association Annual Steak Fry_** Last week, Congressman Chabot attended the annual Steak Fry hosted by the St. Bernard Police Benevolent Association. As always, thank you to the officers for their service. It was a great event! **_New Ad - Chabot Campaign's Second TV Ad: Cincinnati Mom Says "Our Families Can't Afford Greg Landsman in Congress"_**_Mom Highlights Former Pelosi Staffer Landsman 's Record of Tax Hikes and Support for Out-of-Control Policies in Washington That Are Hurting Families_Congressman Steve Chabot's campaign released its second television ad of the 2022 cycle on Wednesday. The ad, called "[Can't Afford](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjpltky-kujkulhluu-y/)," highlights former Nancy Pelosi staffer Greg Landsman's record of support tax hikes on the Cincinnati City Council and support for more of the Pelosi tax-and-spend agenda in Washington that is fueling inflation and hurting families."The Landsman-Pelosi tax-and-spend agenda pushed inflation to a forty-year high and hit hardworking families with rising costs on everyday essentials," said Chabot for Congress campaign manager John Gomez. "That burden has been exacerbated for families living in Cincinnati by Landsman's support for repeated tax hikes on the City Council. Southwest Ohio families simply cannot afford former Pelosi staffer Greg Landsman and his inflation-fueling, tax-hiking, out-of-touch agenda in Washington."Watch the ad, "Can't Afford," [HERE](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjpltky-kujkulhluu-j/).Get the facts on former Pelosi staffer Greg Landsman's record [HERE](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjpltky-kujkulhluu-t/). [](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjpltky-kujkulhluu-i/) **_New Release: Landsman's Pelosi-Inspired Agenda Contributes to Skyrocketing Cincinnati Rents as Out-of-Touch Landsman Falsely Brags About Bringing "Rents Down"_**_Landsman 's Tax Hikes and Fee Increases on the Cincinnati City Council and Support for an Inflation-Fueling Agenda in Washington Dramatically Increase the Burden on Hardworking People and Families_Congressman Chabot's campaign released the following statement on reports of massive rent increases in Cincinnati just days after Landsman bragged about how he "helped get... rents down.""Greg Landsman falsely bragged about how he reduced rents just days before a landmark report found rents in the Cincinnati area are skyrocketing, increasing by more than 25 percent in the last year, as a direct result of Landsman's Pelosi-inspired agenda," Chabot campaign manager John Gomez said. "Landsman's repeated support for tax hikes and fee increases on the Cincinnati City Council and for his former boss Nancy Pelosi's inflation-fueling agenda in Washington are dramatically increasing the burden on hardworking people and families in our area.""Not only have Landsman's policies made it more expensive for families to afford rent, but he has also repeatedly voted to hike property taxes and fees making it more expensive to own a home and supported tax hikes and inflation-fueling policies that strain household budgets," Gomez continued. "Landsman's agenda is literally taxing people out of house and home as he continues to show a callous disdain for the impact his disastrous policies have on hardworking people and families.""To get rising costs under control, unleash the full potential of our economy and support greater prosperity in our communities, including the ability to afford housing, we have to reject Landsman, fire Nancy Pelosi and stop their shared tax-hiking, inflation-fueling agenda," Gomez said. "On the campaign trail, Landsman refused to identify rising costs as a top issue, said 'what does it matter' when talking about his support for the Pelosi agenda and now brags about lowering rents as Cincinnati-area families face 25 percent rent increases -- Landsman is simply too out of touch and too extreme to be in Congress."The Cincinnati Enquirer reported on Thursday that "the overall median rent in the Cincinnati metro area reached $1,682 in August, up about 25.8% from the same month a year ago." The article notes "there's no single reason why rents have been growing at such an alarming rate, but inflation and rising interest rates are pricing many buyers out of the housing market and increasing the pressure to rent."Rising interest rates are a direct result of Federal Reserve efforts to combat inflation that has remained at a 40-year high as a direct result of tax-and-spend policies supported by Landsman in Washington. Landsman also voted to increase property taxes, making it harder for people to afford a home, and he has repeatedly voted for other tax hikes and fee increases that contributed to rising rents and make it more expensive to live in Cincinnati. Get the facts [here](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjpltky-kujkulhluu-d/). **_This Week 's Blog - "The Democrat's Plan"_**This week's blog post is about what Democrats will do if they retain power this November and the devastating effects it will have on our country:_" What they plan to do should scare the bejesus out of all right-thinking people (and by right-thinking I don't necessarily mean conservative-thinking, I mean sound-thinking or common sense-thinking.)"_Read the blog post [here](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjpltky-kujkulhluu-h/). **_Volunteer and Join Team Chabot Today!_** Chabot for Congress is always welcoming volunteers to help bring us across the finish line this fall. There are plenty of ways to volunteer, including helping us deliver yard signs, knocking doors, and making phone calls. For more information visit our site at the link [here ](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjpltky-kujkulhluu-k/)or email our Political Director Jason Sponaugle at jsponaugle@stevechabot.com. Have a great weekend.Yours truly,John GomezCampaign Manager - Chabot for Congress [Donate](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjpltky-kujkulhluu-u/) [Get a Yard Sign](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjpltky-kujkulhluu-o/) [](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjpltky-kujkulhluu-b/) [](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjpltky-kujkulhluu-n/)[](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjpltky-kujkulhluu-p/)[](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tjpltky-kujkulhluu-z/) [ Share ](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-fb-tjpltky-kujkulhluu-e/) [ Tweet ](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-tw-tjpltky-kujkulhluu-s/) [ Forward ](https://stevechabotforcongress.forwardtomyfriend.com/r-kujkulhluu-961825B2-tjpltky-l-g) | Chabot for Congress, P.O. Box 54461, Cincinnati, OH 45254 You are receiving this email because of your connection to our cause. Hello,
I was a three-star admiral, but when Donald Trump was elected, I voted with my feet and retired after 36 years in the U.S. Navy. Life is about choices, and I was not going to work for a demagogue such as Trump.
**Because here’s something you won’t hear anyone on Fox ‘Entertainment’ News admit: Donald J. Trump was – and still is – a national security threat.**
Trump wanted to withdraw from NATO, cozied up to our enemies, and alienated our allies. He attacked our democracy and incited an armed insurrection on our Capitol. He tried to hold military aid to Ukraine hostage, and who knows what kind of _kompromat_ Russia has on him...
Twice Donald Trump was impeached. And twice Chuck Grassley stood by his side. **It’s time for my opponent Senator Chuck Grassley to stand on a bit of principle and finally repudiate any affiliation with Donald Trump. If you don't stand against him, then you stand with him.**
I’m running for Senate because Republicans like Chuck Grassley are still acting like Trump’s lap dogs. They’ll do nothing to confront the climate crisis, take on Big Pharma and the NRA, or rein in Wall Street. And when I defeat Chuck Grassley, Iowa will be represented by the most senior military person ever-elected to the U.S. Senate. That sounds fitting right about now.

---
Fellow Patriot, [**I urge you, right this second, to sign the National Petition for an Article V Convention of States to save America**.](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z3ebkstbjduku7hllk086onr1c6vf4mu49sv53c0_rp22sh2s8i66or1c1h60o71c5h2bs) An army of conservative heroes including **_Mark Levin, Ben Shapiro, Sean Hannity,_** and** _Lt. Col. Allen West_** have joined our movement to call for an Article V Convention of States. [**Just click here to add your name to this national petition. And then PLEASE forward this email to every single person you know.**](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z02uu0b3gjql77upphv18edkp5co95md8fh1phig_rp22sh2s8i66or1c1h60o71c5h2bs)
---
[**Sign The Petition**](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zngeo7ed756f4ajtu2coc7f66srf6ft50h9aaof8_rp22sh2s8i66or1c1h60o71c5h2bs)
---
Our nation is spiraling out of control. Debt threatens to cripple our economy. Federal spending has never been higher -- nor has our deficit. And the politicians in Washington won't do anything to save us. _In fact, most of them are part of the problem!_ A Convention of States is our only hope. You see, our Founding Fathers were brilliant men. They left an emergency clause in the Constitution in case the federal government got too big and out-of-control. **Article V of the Constitution allows the states to bypass Congress and the President to call a Convention of States to propose amendments to our Constitution that will rein in the federal government.** Well, conservative leaders all across the country -- along with over **_FIVE MILLION_** grassroots patriots -- believe it is time to invoke Article V and call a Convention of States for the express, _limited_ purpose of imposing fiscal restraints and term limits on Congress and limiting the power, scope, and jurisdiction of the federal government. Fellow American, We knew it was just a matter of time before another woke company canceled us... but we didn't see this one coming. A few weeks ago, we received an unexpected email from Front, the company that manages all inbound and outbound email for the team here at the Babylon Bee, informing us that they had terminated our account, effective immediately. Sure enough, moments later, we were unable to send or receive email. For weeks afterwards, our team scrambled. We’re a company spread across multiple cities, so email is essential to our operation. Needless to say, this one hurt. Front decided to drop the bomb on us in whatever way would disrupt us the most, and they succeeded. But _why_ would they do such a thing? By now, I'm sure you have a good guess. It probably comes as no surprise that Front is run by a group of woke, left-wing tech elitists. Just like Twitter, Facebook, _The New York Times_ , Snopes, and the many other companies that have attacked us, they simply can’t abide satire that dares to mock their left-wing orthodoxy. So they orchestrated their attack to do the most damage they possibly could. [**We’ve been through attacks like this before, and we know that there are more coming — which is why I'm reaching out to free speech-loving friends like you who value good satire, asking you to become a paid subscriber of the Babylon Bee today.**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zdn1fc7nl6d6iko71mroqvv6nnpn8slmolla681g_rp22sh2s8i66or1c1h66oj2chh2bs)
---
[**Become a Subscriber Today >>**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zf6dncmi5or6eoo8m918ir04u11t2lvte74kd970_rp22sh2s8i66or1c1h66oj2chh2bs)
---
For years now, we’ve been building our support base in an effort to become “cancel-proof” — so that radical companies like Front can't pull the rug out from under us like this. We've come a long way, but as this episode proved, we're still vulnerable. [**You can help with your subscription today**.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zie89bh9hgo8b6vp2b2ev9jcvr03pej6vp33kjig_rp22sh2s8i66or1c1h66oj2chh2bs) And remember — you won’t just be standing with the Bee; you’ll be standing up for free speech of all kinds online, and showing left-wing elitists that they can try to censor free thinkers like us, but the truth will always win out. If you're familiar with the Babylon Bee, you know that we're no strangers to this sort of treatment. We've been canceled, censored, shadow-banned, locked out, and kicked off by more left-wing operations than I can count, for no other reason than that the woke just can’t take a joke. As a matter of fact, we've been locked out of our Twitter account for the past three months because we refuse to delete our satirical post honoring transgender Biden appointee Dr. Rachel Levine as our “Man of the Year.” But thanks to our network of subscribers, we can weather these storms better than ever before. Thanks to thousands of friends just like you who see the value of investing in free speech and good satire, we're still pushing forward. [**But today, I'm asking you to join us. If you've been on the fence, now really is the time. Don't wait until our next cancellation. Please help us build resiliency today by becoming a subscriber.**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2znqflclq8qcuq8qe4k09oc8no8r0dgehnolhfu6o_rp22sh2s8i66or1c1h66oj2chh2bs) Our goal is quite simple: to become the Obi Wan Kenobi of the digital world. To paraphrase the great sage himself, with friends like you united behind us, the woke tech elites can’t win. They can try to strike us down, but we will become more powerful than they could possibly imagine. [**Join the rebellion today.**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zkp2kmrenpc508e3l6fr5hv4ph5vrj7vv5b6c608_rp22sh2s8i66or1c1h66oj2chh2bs)

Ok, now onto the good stuff.
I was born in Reading, Pennsylvania when my parents were just two teenagers starting out on their own. I love my parents, even if Gisele is their favorite.
We started out struggling. My dad was a union grocery worker at ShopRite, working night shifts. The union way of life helped keep our family together while he went to college. Dad ended up graduating, and got a good job as an underwriter.
After we moved, I grew up in suburban south central Pennsylvania. I graduated from Central York High School and went to college in Reading, just like my dad did.
When I left Pennsylvania for grad school, I *never* envisioned myself ending up in public service — not as Mayor of Braddock for 15 years, and certainly not as Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51245257/368756635/-88209209?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2035-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMDE4OGI1ZS0wZTNjLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DvZVv4oDVvh-99nCu_MQl5Qy5QKUqqTvlj_RkCbNsbg=)
But I came back to Pennsylvania because that's where my heart is. And alongside my amazing wife, Gisele, I have dedicated my life to improving our Commonwealth.
When Pennsylvania lawmakers pushed outdated, discriminatory policies banning marriage equality, I officiated one of the first gay marriages in Pennsylvania. 🌈
When Braddock was overlooked and counted out, we created jobs and got young people engaged. We created a community center, urban gardens, and a free store run by Gisele. ✊
And when the Pennsylvania GOP sent their flag police to take down my weed + pride flags, I put them back up. I’m just gonna keep doing that. ✅

I was born in Reading, Pennsylvania when my parents were just two teenagers starting out on their own. I love my parents, even if Gisele is their favorite. We started out struggling. My dad was a union grocery worker at ShopRite, working night shifts. The union way of life helped keep our family together while he went to college. Dad ended up graduating, and got a good job as an underwriter. After we moved, I grew up in suburban south central Pennsylvania. I graduated from Central York High School and went to college in Reading, just like my dad did. When I left Pennsylvania for grad school, I never envisioned myself ending up in public service — not as Mayor of Braddock for 15 years, and certainly not as Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania. = But I came back to Pennsylvania because that's where my heart is. And alongside my amazing wife, Gisele, I have dedicated my life to improving our Commonwealth. When Pennsylvania lawmakers pushed outdated, discriminatory policies banning marriage equality, I officiated one of the first gay marriages in Pennsylvania. 🌈 When Braddock was overlooked and counted out, we created jobs and got young people engaged. We created a community center, urban gardens, and a free store run by Gisele. ✊ And when the Pennsylvania GOP sent their flag police to take down my weed + pride flags, I put them back up. I’m just gonna keep doing that. ✅ = If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately and be split between John Fetterman and Jacky Rosen: | | | = | | = | | = | | = You may like Wawa more than Sheetz. You may say #FlyEaglesFly while I say #HereWeGo. But help send me to the U.S. Senate and I’ll fight for all of youse, just like I’ve been fighting for Pennsylvania my whole life. body:

| | | Peter,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $25 makes a difference. $25 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61378342:JZqDoaVtN:m:1:3345639852:0A9C5F120A8AD7A9A08B950DC03CDEE9:r "Johnson1")**_

Please, Peter, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

This is a longer email than usual but for the past months, I have become the #1 target of the Left, the liberal biased media, and Big Tech giants like Facebook, Twitter, and YouTube.

I have been silenced, censored, and suspended by the social media oligarchs because I tell the truth, and oftentimes, it is the truth the liberal mainstream media does not want to hear. It counters their narrative, and they refuse to allow it. So they silence free speech.

Yet, despite all of this unconstitutional collusion between these far-Left parties working for political gain at the expense of the American people, I will not give up. They will not deter me.
And that is why I decided to run for re-election.

I am running for a third term for the simple reason that I believe I am the best person for the job. I believe that I am the best candidate to address the national debt, work to lower inflation, secure the border, and fight for America First policies. I believe I am the best candidate to put an end to the Biden administration's constant record of misinformation and their continued lack of transparency with Congress, the press, and you, Friend. I believe I am the best candidate for Wisconsin because I tell the truth and speak for the minority, even when the majority is doing everything they can to silence me.

Now that I have announced, the Left will seize every opportunity to destroy me politically. They will continue to write manipulative hit pieces and orchestrate smear campaigns across all mediums. They will attack and distort my record of success, my record of searching for the truth, and my record of fighting for the people of Wisconsin in any way they can. The Democrats even placed a $2M ad buy just moments after I announced my campaign for re-election.

And that's why I need your help.

body:
Vaccine/China Ties!

[INSIDE JW]

Judicial Watch Sues Secret Service Over Hunter Biden’s Gun

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60376&L=28159&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly95b3V0dS5iZS9kWUh0eVJQcnpVND91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=]

When Hunter Biden gets into trouble, he drags others down with him.
And that includes government agents whose role to protect the
presidential family is perverted.

We filed a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit against the
Department of Homeland Security for Secret Service records related to
the investigation of Hunter Biden’s gun, reportedly disposed of in a
dumpster in Delaware (_Judicial Watch, Inc. v. U.S. Department of
Homeland Security_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60376&L=28122&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZGhzLWh1bnRlci1iaWRlbi1ndW4tY29tcGxhaW50LTAyODQxLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=]
(No. 1:22-cv-02841)).

Judicial Watch sued after the United States Secret Service, a
component of DHS, failed to respond adequately to our March 25, 2021,
FOIA request for records or communications about the reported
purchase, possession, and disposal of a firearm owned by Hunter Biden
found in a Delaware dumpster circa October 2018.

We, like many Americans, want to know whether and how the Secret
Service intervened for Hunter Biden in an incident involving a gun
owned by him.

In October 2020, _The Blaze_ reported
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60376&L=28123&F=T&]
that in October 2018, Hunter Biden’s handgun was taken by Hallie
Biden, the widow of then-presidential nominee Joe Biden’s son Beau.
In 2021, _POLITICO_ reported
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60376&L=28124&F=T&

Hallie took Hunter’s gun and threw it in a trash can behind a

THE CHEERFUL, COURAGEOUS KEN STARR

For years we watched the Bill and Hillary Clinton skirt the law and
propriety time and again, and they are still at it. Among those who
tried to rein them in, one person stands tall – Kenneth Starr, the
brilliant jurist who served as independent counsel looking into their
misdeeds. Our chief investigative reporter, Micah Morrison, knew him
personally and in this special Judicial Watch _Investigative Bulletin_
looks back
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60376&L=28141&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvdGhlLXJlYWwta2VuLXN0YXJyLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=]
at the
man and his cheerful courage.

Funeral services for former Whitewater independent counsel Ken Starr
will be held Saturday in Waco, Texas. Starr died September 13 in
Houston. He was 76, a son of Texas. Coverage of his passing was
entirely predictable: the media, the Left, and the academy vilified
him in death precisely as they had vilified him in life.

A representative story, from _POLITICO_, sets the tone. It’s
headlined “Ken Starr: the Man who Created the Lewinsky Scandal.”
The subhead: “His colorless exterior masked an inner zeal that left
an indelible mark on U.S. politics.” Writes David Greenberg, a
professor of history at Rutgers University: Starr was “a motive
force” behind the Lewinsky Affair, “the man who turned what should
have been a dispassionate legal inquiry into a frenzied political
inquisition.”

You get the idea. And the truth is, the smear, engineered by the
Clinton White House, was wildly successful. The popular image, the
cultural shorthand, the “Ken Starr” trope—to anyone who lived
through the 1990s, the first picture that comes to mind, even today,
is Starr the zealot, the humorless prig, the Javert
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60376&L=28130&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuc3Bhcmtub3Rlcy5jb20vbGl0L2xlc21pcy9jaGFyYWN0ZXIvamF2ZXJ0Lz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=]
bent on
destroying Jean Valjean.

But to anyone who knew Ken Starr—and I knew him pretty well—the
popular image is pure character assassination. Politics is a rough
business and in Washington, as another casualty of the Clinton era,
Vincent Foster, once said, “ruining people is considered sport.”
Ken Starr knew that. He was no babe in the Washington woods. And yet,
at least in the early years of the Whitewater probe, Starr often
seemed taken aback by the level of vitriol coming from the White House
and its allies, and he was always on the lookout for the better angels
in the nature of Bill and Hillary Clinton. Maybe this time they would
cooperate, maybe this time they would tell the truth, produce the
documents, stop the stonewall. But it was not to be. Mrs. Clinton,
with her continual evasions and obfuscations, her repeated failures of
memory, her missing billing records
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60376&L=28131&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuc3Bva2VzbWFuLmNvbS9zdG9yaWVzLzE5OTYvamFuLzA2L3doaXRlLWhvdXNlLWxvY2F0ZXMtbWlzc2luZy1kb2N1bWVudHMtbGVnYWwvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==],
was a particular disappointment.

Monica Lewinsky came late to the Whitewater investigation, when the
independent counsel had scored some important wins and suffered some
big losses. After more than four years of high-pressure prosecutions,
Starr was looking to wrap it up. But once the facts began to emerge in
the Lewinsky case, he did not—he could not—turn away.

Start with—to summon a phrase from a later era—start with a #MeToo
fact: the president of the United States had coerced—is there any
other word for it? —a 24-year-old intern, Ms. Lewinsky, into nine
sexual encounters, including oral sex.

Add the legal fact: in a sexual harassment lawsuit brought by a former
Arkansas state employee, Paula Jones, President Clinton had lied under
oath, denying that he had sexual relations with Ms. Lewinsky.

Add the evidentiary fact: a former White House employee brought Starr
prosecutors tape recordings of Lewinsky discussing her affair with the
president, including illegal attempts to cover it up.

Starr stayed silent about the Whitewater probe for decades. But in
2018, he published a memoir, “Contempt: A Memoir of the Clinton
Investigation
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60376&L=28132&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS9Db250ZW1wdC1DbGludG9uLUludmVzdGlnYXRpb24tS2VuLVN0YXJyL2RwLzA1MjU1MzYxMzJdLuKAnT91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=
In it, he wrote, “I deeply regret that I took on the Lewinsky phase
of the investigation. But at the same time, as I still see it 20 years
later, there was no practical alternative to my doing so.”

President Clinton was impeached in the House of Representatives in
1998 for lying under oath and obstructing justice, only the second
impeachment of a president in U.S. history. He was acquitted at trial
in the Senate. A federal judge later found him in contempt of court
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60376&L=25631&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cud2FzaGluZ3RvbnBvc3QuY29tL3dwLXNydi9wb2xpdGljcy9zcGVjaWFsL2NsaW50b24vc3Rvcmllcy9jb250ZW1wdDA0MTM5OS5odG0/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE]
for giving “intentionally false testimony.” And in a deal to avoid
prosecution after leaving the presidency, Clinton agreed to surrender
his law license for five years and pay a $25,000 fine for giving false
testimony in the Jones case.

Back in Arkansas, the Whitewater investigation—a sprawling federal
probe centered around the Clintons’ relationship with the owners of
a corrupt savings and loan—Starr succeeded in a sweeping corruption
cleanup. He obtained fourteen convictions, including from Mr.
Clinton’s successor as governor, Jim Guy Tucker, S&L owners James
and Susan McDougal, and Mrs. Clinton’s former law firm partner,
Webster Hubbell, who had come to Washington with the Clintons to serve
as associate attorney general.

But the Clintons themselves proved elusive. The Starr team, after much
deliberation, concluded they did not have enough evidence to convince
a jury beyond a reasonable doubt that Mrs. Clinton was guilty of
financial crimes and obstruction of justice in the Whitewater affair.
(In 2016, Judicial Watch released 246 pages of previously undisclosed
Office of Independent Counsel internal memos
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60376&L=28134&F=T&]
revealing the possible criminal charges against Hillary Clinton and
Webster Hubbell.) The independent counsel drew up a draft indictment
of Mrs. Clinton—a document that remains under seal in the National
Archives, despite years of Judicial Watch legal actions
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60376&L=28135&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9jYXNlbGF3LmZpbmRsYXcuY29tL3VzLWRjLWNpcmN1aXQvMTg4MTQ2MC5odG1sP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==]
to bring it
to light. The Clinton Whitewater case was never brought to trial.

To prosecutors, there were six key insiders who could provide
significant information about allegations of corruption against the
Clintons regarding the Whitewater land deal (a McDougal-Clinton
partnership connected to the McDougals’ corrupt Madison Guaranty
S&L); billing records under subpoena that had mysteriously vanished
from Mrs. Clinton’s law firm; and other apparent illegal loans and
payoffs.

The six key insiders were Mr. and Mrs. Clinton, James and Susan
McDougal, Webster Hubbell, and Vincent Foster.

All fell silent.

The Clintons refused to talk. Hubbell, facing jail time, promised
cooperation in exchange for a reduced sentence, but as funds from
allies of the Clintons flowed to the beleaguered Arkansas insider, his
cooperation with federal authorities dried up. Susan McDougal
defiantly refused to testify before a grand jury and served a lengthy
jail sentence for contempt; later, President Clinton pardoned her.
James McDougal, convicted for corruption in a Starr prosecution,
agreed to cooperate with the independent counsel, but died in prison
before he could make good on his promise. Vincent Foster, another
Hillary Clinton law firm partner and deputy White House counsel, died
by his own hand shortly after coming to Washington with the Clintons.

The Starr team played a key role in answering questions about the
Foster death, as well as the Travel Office affair, and “Filegate.”

Foster’s body was discovered in a small federal park near Washington
with a gunshot wound to the head in July, 1993. His death touched off
a storm of controversy in Washington. News soon emerged that files had
been removed from Foster’s White House office by Clinton loyalists.
Questions swirled. Had Foster really committed suicide, or was he
murdered?

Initial inquiries by the Park Police and Robert Fiske—a federal
prosecutor who led the Whitewater probe before Starr’s
appointment—were deemed unsatisfactory by the media and Congress.
Starr took over the death probe, brought in the FBI and outside
forensic experts, and eventually issued a painstakingly detailed
report
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60376&L=28136&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cud3NqLmNvbS9hcnRpY2xlcy9TQjg4MDQxMjMxMDg4OTE5MTAwMD91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=]
addressing
all the issues surrounding the Foster suicide, largely putting the
matter to rest.

In the Travel Office affair, Starr investigated allegations that
federal crimes were committed related to the firings, apparently at
Mrs. Clinton’s behest, of the seven-member White House team that
handled bookings for presidential-related travel. Mrs. Clinton wanted
the Travel Office team replaced with Clinton cronies. The head of the
Travel Office, Billy Dale, was accused of misdeeds and indicted by a
federal grand jury. He was swiftly acquitted at trial. Starr’s
conclusion? The behavior by the White House in the Travel Office
affair was “mean-spirited” but “did not amount to a federal
crime,” he wrote in his memoir. But it “certainly revealed
Hillary’s character and her contempt for regular order.”

“Filegate” centered around the Clintons’ inappropriate
requisition of FBI files, supposedly for background checks of
potential incoming personnel. “Forbidden files from the FBI’s
vaults had landed” in a White House personnel office, Starr wrote.
Somebody should have smelled a rat and raised questions. No one did.
Extensive forensic analysis showed that neither of the Clintons had
handled the FBI files. Filegate, Starr wrote, revealed that the White
House was “cavalier in its approach to staffing a hypersensitive
position within the Executive Office complex.” But, he noted,
“exercising poor judgment...is not a crime.”

Starr had come a long way. His father was a hardscrabble Church of
Christ minister and part-time barber, his mother a homemaker. He grew
up in the remote north Texas town of Vernon, but was not destined to
stay. Brilliant, outgoing, he made his way to law school at Duke, and
to a clerkship with Chief Justice Warren Burger. He rose fast, moving
from private practice in Los Angeles to serve as aide to William
French Smith, who had been named attorney general at the Reagan
Justice Department. In 1983, at age 37, Starr was appointed to the
prestigious U.S. Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia. He
made no secret of his ambition: a seat on the Supreme Court—not out
of reach for an ambitious young conservative who had landed on the DC
circuit court. In 1989, he accepted President George Bush’s offer to
become solicitor general. In 1993, with the Bush loss to Bill Clinton,
he returned to private practice.

Then the Special Division of the Court of Appeals came calling, asking
if he would accept appointment as independent counsel in the
Whitewater matter. After a few days of consideration, he accepted the
offer.

“Ever the optimist,” Starr wrote, “I anticipated taking six
months to wrap things up. From the outside, the Whitewater case looked
like nothing more than a failed land deal in Arkansas.”

Of course, it turned out to be much more than that. The months turned
into years, the attacks grew, the controversies multiplied.
Whitewater, Foster, Travel Office, Filegate, Lewinsky. Increasingly
beleaguered, in conversations and statements Starr continually
returned to notions of duty and the rule of law. These were no longer
abstract notions, but life principles—his Whitewater destiny. It
came at considerable cost. He stepped down as independent counsel in
1999. Gone was any chance for a seat on the Supreme Court. Gone was
any chance to return to the DC circuit court, a job he loved.

Life took a different path, not always easy. In 2016, he stepped down
as president and chancellor of Baylor University in Texas when a
sexual assault scandal
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60376&L=28137&F=T&]
swept the school. “The captain goes down with the ship,” he said
at the time, though he was not personally implicated in any
wrongdoing. His resignation, he said, was “a matter of
conscience.”

“He was a very courageous man,” recalled Hickman Ewing Jr., the
famed Memphis federal prosecutor who served as Starr’s deputy
independent counsel. Ewing, like Starr, is a man of strong Christian
faith. During the Whitewater probe, “Starr often had his faith
ridiculed,” Ewing said, “it was not pleasant,” but it did not
change his essential nature. “He liked to call himself ‘a joyful
optimist,’ and I think that’s correct,” Ewing said. “He was a
man, in the words of Paul’s Epistle to the Galatians, steeped in
‘the Fruit of the Spirit: love, joy, peace, patience, kindness,
goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control.’ That was the real
Ken Starr.”

IMMIGRATION COURTS DISMISS ‘HISTORICAL RECORD’ CASES, WILL TRIPLE
LAST YEAR’S

Our southern border has essentially collapsed, and all too often the
federal government is no longer even trying to pretend to
“adjudicate” cases according to law, as our _Corruption
Chronicles_ blog reports
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60376&L=28160&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvaW1taWdyYXRpb24tY291cnRzLWRpc21pc3MtaGlzdG9yaWNhbC1yZWNvcmQtY2FzZXMvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==].

The record-breaking number—more than 2 million and counting—of
illegal immigrants that have entered the U.S. through Mexico this year
has inevitably received considerable media attention lately, but there
is another alarming figure that deserves coverage. Federal immigration
courts have closed a “historical record” 375,000 cases in the
first 11 months of fiscal year 2022, which ends in September, thanks
to Biden administration policies largely dictated by leftist open
border groups. The nation’s immigration court system is on pace to
triple last year’s case closures, according to a report
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60376&L=28161&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly90cmFjLnN5ci5lZHUvcmVwb3J0cy82OTUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==]
published this month by Syracuse
University’s Transactional Records Access Clearinghouse (TRAC),
which documents the unparalleled accelerated rate in which immigration
cases are being dismissed.

In fact, under Biden the number of illegal immigrants granted asylum,
removal waivers and other types of deportation relief has increased
significantly, according to Department of Homeland Security (DHS)
figures obtained by TRAC, a nonpartisan data research center dedicated
to studying the inner workings of the federal government. The
administration’s lax policies have already resulted in a 50%
increase in dismissed immigration cases this year over the previous
high in 2019 under President Donald Trump, TRAC found. The New York
university research center predicts that at this rate an additional
hundreds of thousands of cases will be closed by the end of the fiscal
year. “The pace of closures has also been accelerating
month-by-month since October of 2021,” TRAC researchers write.
“During the past four months, monthly closures blew past 40,000 and
topped 50,000 during May and June. If average closures during these
past four months of 48,721 continue, this would represent an
annualized rate approaching 600,000.”

The biggest growth in immigration case closures occurred in three key
areas, according to TRAC: the much higher numbers of cases that are
terminated, the higher number of cases in which the government never
filed a Notice to Appear (NTA) for the illegal immigrant and the Biden
administration’s implementation of prosecutorial discretion to shut
down cases that are not a priority for deportation. An NTA alleges
that DHS has reason to deport an individual and asks an immigration
judge to issue a removal order, but there has been a big jump in cases
immediately dismissed because DHS failed to file the required
paperwork, the government figures show. “The number of cases closed
by termination where the underlying charges against the immigrant are
not upheld grew 86 percent between FY 2017 and FY 2022,” TRAC
writes. “Many of these cases were quite old, indeed some stretching
back to the earliest still pending cases going back to 1996. These
appear to represent cases where the circumstances have changed so that
the basis for a removal are no longer present if they even once
existed. Terminating these cases helped to clear out the Court’s
backlog.”

Earlier this year TRAC reported a “dramatic increase
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60376&L=28162&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly90cmFjLnN5ci5lZHUvaW1taWdyYXRpb24vcmVwb3J0cy82OTEvXeKAnT91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=
(one out of every
six) in new cases DHS initiates in immigration court being dismissed
because Customs and Border Protection (CBP) officials are not filing
NTAs with the court. Researchers call it a worrying component in the
increase in court dispositions but point out that much more is going
on that is contributing to the rapid rise in immigration case
completions. For instance, TRAC reveals that dismissals jumped in June
2021 following an Executive Office for Immigration Review (EOIR)
directive
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60376&L=28163&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVzdGljZS5nb3YvZW9pci9ib29rL2ZpbGUvMTQwMzQwMS9kb3dubG9hZD91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=]
allowing cases to be dismissed based on prosecutorial discretion. The
order says Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) attorneys will
determine which cases are enforcement priorities and which are not by
exercising discretion based on individual circumstances.

While a record number of immigration cases get dismissed in federal
court, the nation keeps getting crushed with a staggering flow of
migrants, more than 2 million with the fiscal year not even over yet.
In May, Border Patrol agents shattered a monthly record
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60376&L=28164&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuY2JwLmdvdi9uZXdzcm9vbS9uYXRpb25hbC1tZWRpYS1yZWxlYXNlL2NicC1yZWxlYXNlcy1tYXktMjAyMi1tb250aGx5LW9wZXJhdGlvbmFsLXVwZGF0ZT91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=]
with nearly 240,000 encounters along the Mexican border. Nevertheless,
Vice President Kamala Harris, the Biden administration’s border
czar, recently insisted in a national news broadcast that the border
is secure
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60376&L=28165&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubmJjbmV3cy5jb20vbWVldC10aGUtcHJlc3MvbWVldC1wcmVzcy1zZXB0ZW1iZXItMTEtMjAyMi1uMTI5ODgyNj91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=].

Until next week ...
