subject: This is an email about a fascinating case I tried as a young prosecutor. It involved someone doing Russia’s bidding — long before Trump.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR CONGRESS
body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=950%2E5257348%2E8nC4ri ]Adam Schiff for Congress

Derek —

Here’s something you probably don’t know about me — before I ever was in
politics, I convicted an FBI agent who was spying for Russia during the
Cold War. This is not our usual campaign email, but I think you’ll find it
interesting. Trust me.

It was a classic sex for secrets case, and the biggest case of my career.
That was, until I investigated Donald Trump and presented the case at his
first impeachment trial.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1312?c0=sep2022_abs_em.3Qn2Av&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC_20220924_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=950%2E5257348%2E8nC4ri ]Before I go on (and I hope you’re going to want to read on), I want to
ask you to chip in $10 to my campaign, so I can continue holding
Republicans and anyone who seeks to undermine our democracy accountable.

Richard Miller was an FBI agent assigned to the counterintelligence
division (literally the bureau meant to combat Russian influence) in Los
Angeles in the early 1980s. Here’s him with the Russian asset who seduced
him.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=sep2022_abs_em.7fJa3M&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC_20220924_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=950%2E5257348%2E8nC4ri ][IMG]

Miller was recruited by a Soviet emigree named Svetlana. (Why do Russian
spies always seem to be named Svetlana, I used to joke.) After coming to
the United States with her husband, she was disaffected with her new
country and longed to go back to the USSR. But defectors were viewed as
traitors by the Soviet Union and she had to earn her passage home. So, she
became a Russian intelligence asset, and Miller became her target. With
marriage and financial difficulties, Miller was an easy mark.

I’ll spare you the details of their sordid dalliances, which were
numerous. But eventually in 1984, Svetlana made her move, telling Miller
the Russians would pay him for classified documents. Miller asked for tens
of thousands in cash and gold.

He drove up to San Francisco with Svetlana, and provided a Soviet
intelligence officer at the Russian consulate with his FBI badge and a
classified FBI counterintelligence manual to prove he could deliver.

Things only escalated from there, but the FBI caught on to Miller and put
him under surveillance. Miller discovered his tail and went to his
superiors, and concocted an alibi that he was acting as a “secret double
agent.” He was arrested, confessed, and then walked back the confession.
Svetlana and her husband would later plead guilty.

Miller’s first trial was a mistrial, and his second was overturned on
appeal. We had one more chance. That’s when I was brought into the case.
At the time, I was about thirty and serving as an Assistant U.S. Attorney
in Los Angeles.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=sep2022_abs_em.7fJa3M&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC_20220924_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1006&akid=950%2E5257348%2E8nC4ri ][IMG]

It was my first blockbuster trial. And the pressure was immense.

I prepped for months, and during that time, I came into contact with
dozens and dozens of FBI agents who had worked with Miller, but also
investigated him. It was a crash course in the Bureau’s
counterintelligence mission — which I got to know even better many years
later during my time at the Intelligence Committee, and while
investigating Trump.

The Miller trial was in 1990, so of course they gave me a pretty early
version of a cell phone — it looked like the nuclear football, it was that
big! I worked on the case all day and was on that big phone with agents
all night.

The trial commenced less than a year after the Berlin Wall came down and
just a couple of years before the Cold War finally ended. This is part of
what I told the jury in my closing argument:

“Miller had betrayed his job, his family, and the entire community that
placed its trust in his hands ... this is a case of government misconduct
and government corruption of the highest and most disturbing order.”

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=sep2022_abs_em.7fJa3M&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC_20220924_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1007&akid=950%2E5257348%2E8nC4ri ][IMG]

The judge agreed, and the weight of the evidence was enough to convict
him. Miller was found guilty, and sentenced to twenty years in prison. He
would go down as the first FBI agent ever convicted of espionage. Sadly,
he would not be the last.

I learned a lot about the Russians during that investigation, the kind of
people they target, their tradecraft, and the vulnerabilities they look
for. They want people with access to information that is of use to them,
and they look for people they can exploit — with marital issues, or who
are motivated by greed or resentment. The Russians found a very, very good
target with Richard Miller.

I’ve made it my mission in the halls of Congress to protect our country
and our democracy, just as I did in the courtroom.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1312?c0=sep2022_abs_em.3Qn2Av&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC_20220924_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1008&akid=950%2E5257348%2E8nC4ri ]That’s why I’m asking you to donate $10, or whatever amount is
meaningful to you today, so we can all do our part to protect our
Democracy and hold those accountable who seek to weaken or destroy it:

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1015?c0=sep2022_abs_em.1gv99K&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC_20220924_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1009&akid=950%2E5257348%2E8nC4ri ]EXPRESS DONATE $10

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1016?c0=sep2022_abs_em.kv22Ah&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC_20220924_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1010&akid=950%2E5257348%2E8nC4ri ]EXPRESS DONATE $25

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1017?c0=sep2022_abs_em.4l49VT&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC_20220924_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1011&akid=950%2E5257348%2E8nC4ri ]EXPRESS DONATE $50

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1018?c0=sep2022_abs_em.aBK6uA&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC_20220924_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1012&akid=950%2E5257348%2E8nC4ri ]EXPRESS DONATE $100

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1019?c0=sep2022_abs_em.sZzA0Q&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC_20220924_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1013&akid=950%2E5257348%2E8nC4ri ]EXPRESS DONATE $250

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=sep2022_abs_em.7fJa3M&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC_20220924_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1014&akid=950%2E5257348%2E8nC4ri ]ANOTHER AMOUNT

Thanks for reading this story, and I hope it helps you understand a little
more about me and what motivates my work. It’s also why I’m so grateful
you’re on my team.

— Adam

clean_body: Peter, Throughout my campaign to represent Missouri’s 2nd District in Congress, I’ve done everything I can to send positive and uplifting messages about our nation and our remarkable corner of the state. I don’t normally say that Senate and House Republicans make me sick, but I have to be honest... This disgusts me: = I don’t know that I’ve ever been so sickened by anything that Lindsey Graham has said or done, and that’s really saying something. Yet after being a reliable rubber stamp for the Senate GOP’s extremist arm, he has the nerve to introduce a bill that will further police our pregnancies. I know we’d all love to hear Ann Wagner explain why she believes the government should mandate pregnancy. But Ann hasn't hosted a public town hall in 3,539 days. We can’t keep doing this. If we don’t stop the GOP today, with a majority in both the House and Senate, they will take away every single inch of progress we’ve made in the last half-century. = There is too much on the line to simply hope for the best—we need to organize, talk to each other, and stand together as a bulwark against extremists like Ann Wagner and the anti-choice zealots interfering in our private lives. Thank you so much for your support. subject: meet my heroes
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warnock for Georgia
body:

Who were your heroes growing up, friend? For me, it was my parents.
Dad was a veteran, a small businessman, and a preacher. He spent his days fixing junk cars that other folks had discarded – and then on Sundays, he preached to the folks who felt discarded.

And Mom? As a teenager, she spent her summers picking cotton in Waycross, Georgia. She raised 12 kids in public housing – and while our family was short on money, we were long on love. **Just last year, those 83-year-old hands that used to pick somebody else's cotton picked her son to be a U.S. senator from Georgia, the first Black senator in our state's history.**
My parents taught me the value of hard work and instilled in me a heart for service. I bring those lessons with me wherever I go, including the Senate, where I'm fighting to build a better, brighter future for all.

**But with _NPR_ calling me the most vulnerable Democratic senator up for reelection, I mean it when I say the only way I can win this race and keep up the fight in Washington is with your urgent help.**

subject: Before I was U.S. Senator for California...
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alex Padilla for Senate
body:
if these MAGA candidates win, they will do everything they can to pave the way for Donald Trump in 2024.
#

Before I was U.S. Senator for California, I served as California’s Secretary of State.
In most states, including California, Secretaries of State are responsible for running free and fair elections — ensuring that everyone who’s eligible to vote gets to exercise that constitutional right to make their voice heard.
[](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-sep22-dass.8K1p2u&refcode=em220924-1-60&t=1&akid=1013%2E159979%2EEASqmA)_Doing my duty as California's Secretary of State_
They’re also in charge of training poll workers, managing voter-registration databases, fighting election-related misinformation, and certifying election results.
It’s an important job, one that’s essential to the functioning of our elections and our government.
That’s why it’s extremely dangerous that MAGA Republicans are running in close races for Secretary of State positions across the country — including in key battleground states where a Secretary of State’s refusal to certify an election could pose a grave threat to our democracy.
**As a former Secretary of State myself, I know what’s at stake. We cannot allow MAGA-right election deniers to assume control of these critically important public offices across the country.**
[**Please, split a donation between my campaign and the Democratic Association of Secretaries of State. GOP candidates in these races pose a grave threat to our democracy — we cannot let them win this November.**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-sep22-dass.8K1p2u&refcode=em220924-1-60&t=2&akid=1013%2E159979%2EEASqmA)
**[DONATE](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-sep22-dass.8K1p2u&refcode=em220924-1-60&t=3&akid=1013%2E159979%2EEASqmA)**
We are facing a radical right-wing movement that continues to call into question the democratic process anytime that it doesn’t work in their favor.
And make no mistake — if these MAGA candidates win, they will do everything they can to pave the way for Donald Trump in 2024.
So thank you for making a donation today if you can afford to do so. It would make a big difference to Secretary of State candidates across the country, and it would mean a lot to me personally as well.
Thank you,
Alex Padilla
U.S. Senator for California
Former Secretary of State of California

body:
| | | Peter, Former President Trump is going on the offensive and appears to be launching a full-scale fight against the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI). We here at the America First Policy Institute are joining the fight. I'm sure you already know the backstory: The FBI recently raided former President Trump's home in what could be politically-motivated. This ordeal should paint a clear picture for us: The deep state is real, and we can't afford to sit around playing defense while the FBI raids a former President's home. **_We MUST go on the offensive._** [**And that 's exactly what I plan to do. Will you help me?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61388790:JBxSJaVeN:m:1:3331421248:A336A5AEE92AC018B925670800FCFCD6:r) _Our country is at risk of crumbling into a banana republic run by the most radical leftists in America and an invulnerable deep state. WE HAVE NO CHOICE BUT TO FIGHT BACK!_ When the news broke, our entire team sprung into action to respond. Within 48 hours, we filed more than 50 Freedom of Information Act requests to expose the Biden Administration and find out who knew what and when. But I assure you, the Department of Justice (DOJ) is not going to hand over information easily, and we may have to battle with the DOJ for months or even YEARS to uncover the truth fully. **We CANNOT sustain our efforts without you ... ** **[Will you chip in before it's to help ensure our efforts can continue?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61388790:JBxSJaVeN:m:1:3331421248:A336A5AEE92AC018B925670800FCFCD6:r)**[ ](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61388790:JBxSJaVeN:m:1:3331421248:A336A5AEE92AC018B925670800FCFCD6:r) Let me back up. My name is Matt Whitaker... I was appointed acting United States Attorney General under former President Trump. In that role, I protected Law and Order both at home and abroad. Today I am Co-Chair of the Center for Law & Justice at the America First Policy Institute, where we strive to protect and preserve the rule of law in this great Nation. Together, we will fight back against the radical Left and end its unjust weaponization of the FBI. The team at America First Policy Institute is the best in the Nation, and we're ready to make a HUGE difference for our country--ESPECIALLY when it comes to uncovering the truth regarding the FBI raid. [**I hope you 'll consider sending in a donation of $25, $35, or $50 today. ** ](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61388790:JBxSJaVeN:m:1:3331421248:A336A5AEE92AC018B925670800FCFCD6:r) Sincerely, Matt Whitaker Co-Chair, Center for Law & Justice America First Policy Institute P.S. We've seen it time and time again. Castro's Cuba. Stalin's Russia. Nazi Germany. Mao's China. Great nations fall to tyranny when governments weaponize law enforcement against patriots and political opponents. [**I 'll fight with every breath to make sure that America doesn't have the same fate. Will you? ** ](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61388790:JBxSJaVeN:m:1:3331421248:A336A5AEE92AC018B925670800FCFCD6:r)

Listen,

Secretary Buttigieg is leading the charge to fix America’s crumbling infrastructure.

But he needs a foolproof strategy to ensure things go according to plan. So we’re asking for your immediate input.

We’re depending on your insight to help us answer crucial questions:
• Do you support electric vehicles or high-speed rail?
• Do you have problems with bridges or potholes in your community?

body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vs6z1QahYN

Anti-Americanism has long been evident in higher education. But
recently, it has spread from college campuses to other areas of
American life.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/os6z1QahYN

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear
fellow American,

Anti-Americanism has long been evident in higher education. But
recently, it has spread from college campuses to other areas of
American life.

Today it
asserts itself in many forms-including critical race theory-in
our government, in our K-12 schools, in our corporations, in the
media, in sports, and even in our military.

The
recent election in Virginia brought the corruption of American
K-12 education, in particular, to the forefront of our national
conversation.

The
breakdown (especially among younger Americans) of informed
patriotism-without which self-government is impossible-is not
something we can allow to continue.

While
there is reason to remain hopeful, there is much work to be done
to reverse the current trends in the months and years ahead.

Education
is where this attack on America began-and it is the battlefield
on which we must engage the Left in defense of liberty and
limited constitutional government.

Hillsdale
College has been deeply engaged in this battle for decades. We
are now determined, with the help of supporters like you, who
agree with Hillsdale's mission, to redouble our efforts at this
crucial time for our nation-no matter the cost.

That's
why we are expanding our Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by
Reaching and Teaching Millions in 2022.

You can
support this vital project through this link:
https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/preserve-freedom-for-future-generations

The
Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching
Millions will give informed patriots across the country the
effective ability to defend liberty through education. And we
need your help.

The
project has three key objectives:

Expand the circulation of Imprimis, our digest of liberty, to
reach millions more Americans.

Increase the number of citizens (especially younger Americans)
enrolling in our free online courses, such as "Constitution 101:
The Meaning and History of the Constitution," "The Great American
Story: A Land of Hope," and our newest course, "American
Citizenship and Its Decline" with Victor Davis Hanson.

Launch additional Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 charter
schools nationwide and provide, free of charge, our American
classical K-12 curriculum (including the new Hillsdale 1776
Curriculum) to thousands more American teachers and
homeschoolers.

And your
generous support is critical to our success. Here's why...

Hillsdale
College conducts its educational outreach efforts on behalf of
liberty-as it does all of its work-while refusing to accept one
penny of government funding, not even indirectly in the form of
federal or state student grants or loans.

So, to
expand this effective program, we will need thousands of gifts
between $25 and $100. This is the range in which most supporters
give. We will also need a significant number of $500 to $1,000
donations. But contributions of any size are appreciated.

We
urgently need your help.

You can
safely and securely renew your support using this link:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60816576:s6z1QahYN:m:3:2532013465:27FC4B75D27195E4DE59B9214DAEB611:r

As the
forces of anti-Americanism redouble their own efforts to
undermine informed patriotism in our schools and our culture, and
to subvert constitutionalism in our government, we must engage
them ever more aggressively-including on the central battlefield
of education.

That's
why I hope you'll make your most generous gift in this critical
year for America.

Every
dollar you can give will help expand our Project to Defend
Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions in 2022.

Thank you
for your generosity. I hope you'll stand with us. Together, we
will work to preserve freedom for future generations of
Americans.

Warm
regards,

Larry P.
Arnn

President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing
Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Friend,

There is a fabulous new book out, __Breaking History: A White House Memoir__ , by my son-in-law, Jared Kushner, and it's doing very well.

He wrote an incredible story about how _**unbelievably**_ successful the Trump Administration was in all respects, _**despite every scam, Witch Hunt, and hoax the Washington establishment fabricated.**_

body:
Basically, the strength of our campaign is about to become public.
#
Hiiii Derek,
I'm coming to you today to ask if you'll please kick in **[your first-ever $5 donation to our campaign to flip PA’s U.S Senate seat before the FEC deadline this coming Friday at 11:59 p.m. ET.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220924-1?refcode=em20220924-7382&refcode2=7382_434096_EkmEhu&akid=7382%2E434096%2EEkmEhu)**
That said, I think my team and I owe you an explanation. Some context, if you will.
Every quarter, campaigns like ours are legally required to report out all our latest fundraising numbers to the Federal Election Commission. **Basically, it’s a public test of the grassroots strength of our campaign.**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220924-1?refcode=em20220924-7382&refcode2=7382_434096_EkmEhu&akid=7382%2E434096%2EEkmEhu)
So, as you might expect, reporters will be scouring these numbers — as will Dr. Oz and everybody on his side. Especially because this is our *last* quarterly deadline before Election Day.
TL: DR; putting up a huge number on Friday, September 30 is a really, really big deal. So (drumroll please...) **we’re setting a goal of $10 million dollars!!!**
**[We've got a helluva ways to go to get there, so I am humbly asking you to please make a $5 donation directly to our campaign before Friday's deadline to help reach our major end-of-quarter goal.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220924-1?refcode=em20220924-7382&refcode2=7382_434096_EkmEhu&akid=7382%2E434096%2EEkmEhu)**
**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220924-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220924-7382&refcode2=7382_434096_EkmEhu&akid=7382%2E434096%2EEkmEhu)**
Look, it's not lost on me that you get a lot of requests from me + my team.
I know they can sometimes start to pile up.
But the reality is that, if we want to win the #1 Most Likely to Flip Senate seat of 2022 on grassroots power alone, then we MUST raise as much money as possible before our *last* FEC deadline happening this Friday, September 30.
**The only way we can win is with _lots_ of online donations — big or small — from people like you.** **[So I've gotta ask: Will you donate your first $5 ahead of this Friday's FEC deadline? It'd really make all the difference as we push ahead toward November.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220924-1?refcode=em20220924-7382&refcode2=7382_434096_EkmEhu&akid=7382%2E434096%2EEkmEhu)**
Thank you for everything. I'll reach back out soon.
❤️ John

Democratic Nominee for U.S. Senate

Peter, I know that it's easy to feel worn down by the world we live in. With the way things are going these days, it's hard to feel hopeful about the future.
For the first time ever, American girls today have fewer freedoms than their mothers had growing up. Meanwhile, a whole generation is worse off than their parents financially. Today, it's harder to get the abortion care you need, put yourself through college, buy a house, or save for retirement than it was decades ago.
There is _so much_ work that we must do to reverse these dangerous trends and get our country back on track. In so many ways, the task ahead of us feels impossibly daunting.
But when I look young people in the eye, when I hear their stories, and when they share their hopes and dreams with huge smiles and endless optimism – **I remember just how bright our future really is.**
Every generation has outdone the last in some way. Each of them has taken up the torch and continued this never-ending work to move our country forward. **And bit by bit, we have gotten closer to true equity, to true opportunities for all, and to a truly kind, compassionate world.**
I promise you that I will never, ever stop working to win that future.
That's why I'm running for Senate. my story.")**__
My name's Tiffany Smiley. I'm a mom of three, veteran's wife, and Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I'm running against a 30-year Democrat incumbent to bring **real change** to our country.

I married my high school sweetheart, Scotty, who was permanently blinded by a suicide bomber while serving in Iraq.

From there, I took on the federal government to fight for the rights that Scotty _**earned**_ as an active duty service member, and I _**won**_.

Fighting for Scotty inspired me to **advocate for _all_ veterans**, so I went to D.C. to speak up for those who put their lives on the line for our country.

Now, I need _your_ help to send me to D.C. to advocate for Washingtonians and all Americans who have been hurt by the terrible policies of Joe Biden and my Democrat opponent Patty Murray.

---
| | [HELP TIFFANY'S CAMPAIGN](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61388860:JPGdMaVNh:m:1:3331421248:9F2236ABACD77562496258D13DFCA5E8:r "HELP
TIFFANY’S CAMPAIGN")
---

Murray has been in office for _**three decades**_ and has done **nothing** to stop the rising crime, homelessness, and drug addiction crisis tearing my beloved home state apart.

I'm running for U.S. Senate because Americans deserve better than the failed leadership they've been stuck with for _years_.

It's time for a _**change**_ in D.C., and I'm the right person for the job.

The latest polls in Washington show that my opponent and I will be _**neck and neck**_ , and I'm getting nervous. We're _finally_ closing in on Murray, but I need your support to cross the finish line.

_**[Can you chip in any amount to help me take the lead to save Washington?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61388860:JPGdMaVNh:m:1:3331421248:9F2236ABACD77562496258D13DFCA5E8:r "Can you chip in any amount to help me

Your support will bring me closer to restoring the American dream from the U.S. Senate.

Tiffany Smiley

Tiffany Smiley

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

Yesterday, a judge in Arizona allowed a near-total abortion ban to take effect in the state. This was a ban written 121 years ago — _before Arizona had even achieved statehood or women had the right to vote_. Arizona’s GOP Attorney General took action to enact the archaic ban following the reversal of _Roe v. Wade_.

**Attorneys General matter, and their decisions can have direct and sweeping policy outcomes for the rights of their constituents.** What happened in Arizona is a dangerous reminder of what happens when extremists hold these offices and support outrageous, unconstitutional, and outdated laws.

We know Chris Carr supports sweeping abortion bans without exceptions for rape or incest. We know that Georgia Republicans are considering further restrictions on reproductive rights that go well beyond HB 481 — including bans on contraception.

Make no mistake: Chris Carr will rubber-stamp any extreme law that passes the legislature, even if it blatantly violates Georgians' rights or the Georgia Constitution.

If the stakes of having an extreme, anti-choice Attorney General weren't clear, yesterday's news out of Arizona should serve as a sobering moment. So right now, we need to do everything we can to stop the same from happening in Georgia.

body:
Only 38% of Puerto Rico has had their power restored.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220924-3423-header&t=1&akid=3423%2E2526796%2EqvaNd6)
As of Thursday, only 38% of Puerto Rico had their power restored following the damage from Hurricane Fiona.
Nearly 360,000 Puerto Ricans were experiencing intermittent water service or no service at all as of Thursday evening, and more than 800 people have been housed in temporary shelters.
In order to support Puerto Ricans suffering from this climate disaster, we identified two organizations who are working with a coalition of partners across the island. Together, we’ve raised more than $30,000 for relief efforts.
We know that in addition to immediate relief, we must build power to fight for the long term investment Puerto Ricans deserve. **That’s why we’re excited to support the Hurricane Fiona Community Respond Fund.**
[Can you chip in $3 to the Hurricane Fiona Community Response Fund to support immediate relief and long-term solutions for Puerto Rico?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220924.n5Dsa8&refcode=em20220924-3423-P_FND_CHA_DIR&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3423%2E2526796%2EqvaNd6)
**[Support Puerto Rico →](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220924.n5Dsa8&refcode=em20220924-3423-P_FND_CHA_DIR&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=3423%2E2526796%2EqvaNd6)**
_100% of your donation will go toward relief efforts._
The Fiona Community Response Fund is led by a coalition of community organizations who are working on immediate response to fulfill Puerto Rico’s needs over both the short and long term. It is a partnership of approximately 25 organizations including the Maria Fund, Taller Salud, Ayuda Legal Puerto Rico, Institutio Agroecologia, Campamento contra las cenizas de Peñuelas, Étnica, and others.
As our climate becomes more unpredictable, our ability to overcome these challenges depends on our capacity for selflessness and caring for one another.
Whether it’s a winter storm in Texas, a fire in Jackson Heights, or a climate disaster in Puerto Rico, this movement has always stepped up in the moments that matter most.
[Thank you for stepping up today and for chipping in whatever you can. Any amount adds up to make an incredible difference. ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220924.n5Dsa8&refcode=em20220924-3423-P_FND_CHA_DIR&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=3423%2E2526796%2EqvaNd6)
In solidarity,
Team AOC

body:
Earlier this month, the community of Uvalde experienced another mass shooting at a park with families and children playing in the afternoon.

Tony Gonzales refuses to take any action to stop gun violence in our towns and communities.Tony sold out the Uvalde community for a pathetic $6,500 in campaign donations from the NRA.

That's $203.12 per victim.

Meanwhile, his fellow Republicans in Congress — who are also bought and paid for by the National Rifle Association (NRA) — are looking for ways to make guns more accessible.

I’m running against him to represent TX-23. Will you join me today and support my campaign with a $3 donation? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-lirayardsigns?refcode=EM_FR_220923Yard_N_JL_90DO_7_NG_N_L1&amount=3]

As a Marine veteran who has had the training to handle weapons of war, I won’t stop fighting to protect our families and loved ones from gun violence.

You’d think watching your own community suffer at the hands of gun violence would have been a wake-up call for Tony, but the reality is that he admitted to checking in with the NRA before voting on gun legislation AFTER the Uvalde shooting.

That’s why I’m running for Congress — because before I vote on a single bill — I won’t call the NRA or special interest groups, I will talk to the people of TX-23 and vote for them.

The only thing stopping me from winning on Election Day is name recognition. If you want to help me beat Tony in November, please chip in $3 today so we can place our last order of yard signs to share across TX-23 and get the word out about our campaign. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-lirayardsigns?refcode=EM_FR_220923Yard_N_JL_90DO_7_NG_N_L1&amount=3]

Contribute $3 » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-lirayardsigns?refcode=EM_FR_220923Yard_N_JL_90DO_7_NG_N_EL15&express_lane=&amount=3]

When Tony was faced with voting on gun legislation, he didn’t waste a minute getting on the phone with the NRA to see how they wanted him to vote.

I believe in servant leadership, and that the people of TX-23 want someone who truly represents them in Congress. Tony is not only an out-of-touch extremist. He is dangerous.

We can’t let him win a second term. He will continue voting with the rest of the GOP, and nothing will ever change in TX-23. It’s our responsibility to get him out of Washington.

Together, we can spread the word about my campaign. Just use this link to rush a donation → https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-lirayardsigns?refcode=EM_FR_220923Yard_N_JL_90DO_7_NG_N_L1&amount=3

Thank you for standing with me,

John Lira

# Calvin Wimbish Veteran, Patriot and Candidate for U.S. House Florida District 10
**America First Always!**
**
**
It's time to fight for our nation, our freedoms, and our shared values. We can't afford to send a weak, inexperienced person to Washington. Our nation faces serious challenges and it needs serious people to solve them. I've always been a fighter, and I won't stop now.

**Dedicated Husband and Father** More than 45 years ago, I married my wife Suzie, and my life has never been the same. Raising our kids wasn’t easy, but as all parents know, it was certainly worth it. My family is what motivates me to make our nation great for generations to come.

**Experienced Leader** In my time fighting evil in the Middle East, I realized just how special our nation truly is. And yet, there are those that want us to copy the ways of failed foreign nations and get rid of the American spirit that unites us. We cannot let them win. Throughout my entire life as a Frederick Douglass Republican, I’ve always stood for freedom, tradition, and a full-hearted belief in the inherent goodness of all people.

**Experienced Educator** With the socialist left wanting to teach Critical Race Theory and talk to schoolchildren about sex, I couldn’t stand on the sidelines any longer. As a local JROTC instructor, I’ve helped instill our next generation of leaders with a love of country, hard work, and dedication.

**Unapologetic Christian** I have relied on God’s providence at every stage in my life. Whether it was dodging bullets in Afghanistan, raising my children alongside my wife, or even deciding to run for Congress, I couldn’t have done it without hope in Christ and reliance on God. In Congress, I’ll bring my much-needed values of faith, family, duty and honor straight to Washington.

<https://votecal2022.org/>

<https://defendourunion.org/candidates/calvin-wimbish-fl-us-house-district-10>

_Thank you,
Sally Baptiste

name: Kari Lake
subject: Peter, are you with me?
body:
| | | [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61381562:63nXnaVNC:m:1:3334294963:859111D4A6DE2F4832536816BF05B499:r)
---
| | Peter, Are there any sane Democrats left who will call out Joe Biden for his insults? He is calling every conservative American a "semi-fascist." He's threatening to use the might of the federal government to murder Republicans. And not one member of the political establishment - including my opponent - will stand up to him. They always agree with everything Joe Biden says because everything he does keeps THEM in power. ENOUGH IS ENOUGH. It's time to fight back and make the government work FOR THE PEOPLE. Not against us!**__**_[**Are you with me?**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61381562:63nXnaVNC:m:1:3334294963:859111D4A6DE2F4832536816BF05B499:r)_**_ _**
---
[**SUPPORT KARI LAKE NOW >>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61381562:63nXnaVNC:m:1:3334294963:859111D4A6DE2F4832536816BF05B499:r)
---
I'm telling you right now that I am a strong conservative who can get things done. I'm the transformative leadership we need. _But you don't need to just take my word for it. _ **I'm endorsed by:**
* * * * * * President Donald Trump
* Governor Ron DeSantis
* Rudy Giuliani
* Marjorie Taylor Green
* Sheriff Joe Arpaio
* Richard Grenell
* General Michael Flynn, and more...

---
[**JOIN PRESIDENT TRUMP: SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61381562:63nXnaVNC:m:1:3334294963:859111D4A6DE2F4832536816BF05B499:r)
---
Together, we're going to unite to solve the problems America is facing right now. And trust me...there's a lot to do.
_But I know I can make it happen because I 've always been able to do anything I set my mind to. And that's not going to stop now!_
---
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61381562:63nXnaVNC:m:1:3334294963:859111D4A6DE2F4832536816BF05B499:r)
---
[ ](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61381562:63nXnaVNC:m:1:3334294963:859111D4A6DE2F4832536816BF05B499:r)
---
I grew up in Iowa. There's not a lot to do there, but that's where I honed my work ethic. I worked hard. I learned to fight. I gained that fighting spirit the old establishment GOP never had -- that's what makes me a part of the NEW RIGHT. I developed that backbone of steel - that "BDE" that President Trump and Governor Ron DeSantis have. And frankly, that we want all of our elected leaders to have. Someone even recently told me "Kari, you're going to be the DeSantis of the West." Other than being called "Trump in a Dress" -- which is my favorite compliment of all -- that is the greatest compliment you could pay me. **To me, that means that you know when you elect me, you 're going to get someone who fights for you every single day. ** We are going to be so effective in Arizona.
---
[**SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61381562:63nXnaVNC:m:1:3334294963:859111D4A6DE2F4832536816BF05B499:r)
---
**Peter, I promise you this, as the governor of Arizona, I will be the biggest pain in the ass Joe Biden 's ever experienced. ** I will unite with conservatives across the country to protect Arizona from this out-of-control federal government. We will save our states and return the power to WE, THE PEOPLE, where it belongs. **_This is our moment to make it happen. _**
---
Make no mistake... My opponent would be a NIGHTMARE to the pro-freedom, pro-America agenda we want to implement. Here's what you should know about Katie Hobbs. ➡️ **_SHE WILL NOT DEFEND YOUR RIGHT TO BEAR ARMS!_** Katie has an F grade when it comes to protecting our Second Amendment rights. I don't know about you, but I feel that our Second Amendment is the most important amendment right now. _It 's the reason that we are still free. _ **➡️ _HER VOTING RECORD IS SHOCKING!_** She'll never talk about it, but 90% of the time when she was in our state legislature, she voted against small businesses. 90 percent! **➡️ _SHE FAILED TO SECURE OUR ELECTIONS._** Hobbs served as Secretary of State in 2020 in one of the most corrupt elections in American history. **➡️ _SHE IS A CONVICTED RACIST!_** Two separate juries unanimously convicted her of racial discrimination, and the taxpayers of Arizona are paying for her crimes! Almost $3 million as a payout for her court settlement because she did not pay Black employees the same as she paid white employees. _That is disgusting._
We cannot afford to let a radical lefty like Katie Hobbs turn Arizona into another California.**__**_[**Will you help me defeat her?**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61381562:63nXnaVNC:m:1:3334294963:859111D4A6DE2F4832536816BF05B499:r)_
---
Now, I don't care if you're with the Democrat Party, the Independent Party, the Republican Party, the Pizza Party, or the Pool Party - our policies are going to help every American. **_[We have to stand together and defeat the left so we can save America](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61381562:63nXnaVNC:m:1:3334294963:859111D4A6DE2F4832536816BF05B499:r)_. ** I hope that you will chip in now to support my campaign for Governor of Arizona.**__**
---
[**SAVE AMERICA: SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61381562:63nXnaVNC:m:1:3334294963:859111D4A6DE2F4832536816BF05B499:r)
---
Sincerely,
---
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61381562:63nXnaVNC:m:1:3334294963:859111D4A6DE2F4832536816BF05B499:r)
---
**Kari Lake** _Candidate for Arizona Governor_
---

I'm running against a 30-year Democrat incumbent to bring **real change** to our country.

I married my high school sweetheart, Scotty, who was permanently blinded by a suicide bomber while serving in Iraq.

From there, I took on the federal government to fight for the rights that Scotty _**earned**_ as an active duty service member, and I _**won**_.

Fighting for Scotty inspired me to **advocate for _all_ veterans**, so I went to D.C. to speak up for those who put their lives on the line for our country.

I'm sorry to crowd your inbox, friend, but I wouldn't bump my last message if it weren't critical to defeating Marco Rubio.

Ohioans care about a wide range of issues, and they don’t see themselves
on some left-right ideological spectrum — they want to know who's on their
side.

Ohioans care about personal freedoms and their children’s futures.

spectrum, and why out-of-touch millionaire JD Vance’s backers are trying
to buy their way into power.

It’s why I’ve been able to win here, and it’s why — in a state Trump won
twice — this race is a dead heat, and anyone could win.

That’s why we need to make sure that Tim’s campaign has the resources to

body:
[1]Beto O'Rourke

This is a
big announcement.

We’re setting a goal to raise $5,000,000 before our upcoming Texas Ethics
Commission filing deadline at midnight on September 29th.

We know that you’re probably getting a lot of fundraising emails right
now. But we wanted to personally reach out and share [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220924-2.PUcG5R&refcode=ema20220924-209355&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=209355%2E444211%2E1VctFZ ]why we think a
donation to help elect Beto as Texas' next governor is one of the best
investments you can make today. Here are just three reasons:

1) To defeat Greg Abbott in seven weeks, we’re continuing to build the
biggest organizing program that Texas has ever seen. But we need the
financial resources to hire organizers, train volunteers, and open new
offices in every single part of Texas.

2) Greg Abbott started this race with more than $50 million in the bank.
We’re relying on grassroots contributions, which means that we’re relying
on folks like you pitching in what they can afford to help us compete
against Abbott’s corporate mega-donors.

3) Beto has a positive, unifying vision for the state of Texas. He’s
focused on the things that will improve Texans’ daily lives – world-class
schools, expanding Medicaid, and great jobs that pay a living wage. Greg
Abbott is leading this state down the wrong path, and his extremism —
including an abortion ban with no exceptions for rape or incest — is
hurting the people of Texas.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220924-2.PUcG5R&refcode=ema20220924-209355&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=209355%2E444211%2E1VctFZ ]We’re running up against the clock to reach our $5,000,000 goal before
midnight on the 29th. Will you pitch in $3 right now to
help us catch up on our fundraising before our TEC deadline? Any amount
helps!

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220924-2.PUcG5R&refcode=ema20220924-209355&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=209355%2E444211%2E1VctFZ ][IMG]

Thank you for everything at such an important moment in history,
Team Beto

Fellow Conservative,

**If I can't tell this story to voters in my district, I'm going to lose my race.**

It would be bad for not just Southwest Oregon, but for the country if I lost on November 8th. Becuase **I think people have had enough of this one party leadership that's obviously taken us down the wrong path.**

It was Friday, August 21, 2015. I boarded train #9364 in Brussels, bound for Paris. My plans were simple and spirits were high. I was on vacation with my two best friends after completing a tour in Afghanistan as a U.S. soldier.

But someone we didn’t expect boarded the train that day too, and he would change our lives forever.

Ayoub El-Khazzani, an ISIS terrorist emerged from the bathroom, bare-chested and armed with a box cutter, an assault rifle, a jar of gasoline, and 270 rounds of ammunition attempted to take over and kill more than 500 passengers.

**And he would have succeeded, except he didn’t know three proud Americans were aboard and ready to fight like hell. I tapped my friend on the shoulder and said: ‘Let’s go.’ **

As a soldier, I was trained to take out a terrorist threat - As an American, I was taught to stand up for freedom no matter where I was in the world. Which is why I, my friends and other brave travelers took the action needed to stop this terrorist.

Don is the most extreme nominee New Hampshire has seen in decades. Whether it’s peddling lies about the 2020 election or telling women to “get over it” when asked about a nationwide abortion ban, his positions speak for themselves. But to understand how he would act as a U.S. Senator, we have to take a look at who is backing him.

subject: Did you see Jocelyn’s message?
disclaimer_text:

Jocelyn Benson for Secretary of State
body:
[https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif] Friend, [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif]
Last week, Jocelyn sent out an important update on the work she’s doing as secretary of state and on the campaign trail.
We’ve got 44 days left until Election Day and the stakes for Jocelyn’s re-election are higher than ever. Read Jocelyn’s message below and pitch in to support her re-election campaign today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/movefast?refcode-092422]
-Team Benson
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Jocelyn Benson
Date: Saturday, September 17, 2022 at 11:35 PM
Subject: An update from me
To: Our friend
With Election Day right around the corner (55 days to be exact) I want to update you on the work I’ve been doing as Secretary of State and on the campaign trail. We’ve got an important month and a half ahead of us!

As Secretary of State, my primary goal between now and Election Day is to make this election as accessible, transparent, and secure as possible. That means looking at our success in 2020 and doing everything we can to build on it in 2022. With our modernized voter registration system, it’s easier than ever for Michiganders to go online to check their voter registration status, register to vote, request an absentee ballot, and then track their ballot in the mail. You can do all of this at Michigan.gov/vote.

My office has also been hard at work updating voter rolls and ensuring that voter fraud remains extremely rare. In 2020, election extremists came up with all sorts of crazy conspiracies about “dead voters,” but they have been debunked by the state Auditor General, the GOP- led state Senate Oversight Committee, the state Bureau of Elections and countless clerks and independent journalists. This year, we’re again working to ensure that our voter lists are as accurate as ever and have established a website that explains exactly how we do this in strict accordance with all relevant state and federal laws. You can check it out here [https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.michigan.gov/sos/elections/upcoming-election-information/voters/voter-cancellation-procedures&sa=D&source=docs&ust=1663344277977899&usg=AOvVaw3x8MDEur1lR_1BUQnrLte4] .
I’m running for re-election so I can continue serving the people of Michigan in this important office. Will you contribution to my re-election campaign today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/movefast?refcode=081622]
I’m also proud that more and more Michiganders are taking advantage of our online services and self-service stations available at many local grocery stores, fulfilling my promise to save you time and effort when accessing the services provided by my office. Meanwhile, office visits continue to take an average of just 20 minutes, which I’m sure is why our online resident ratings continue to average more than four out of five stars. The campaign trail is as exciting and inspiring as ever. It’s great to see so many supporters from across the state showing out and supporting our movement. I’ve always said that I was elected to do two things: improve Secretary of State services and protect the integrity of our elections. And when I meet voters, I’m consistently hearing great feedback about the work we’re doing on both fronts.
While it’s great to meet and hear from voters on the campaign trail, it’s impossible to shake every hand before Election Day. That’s why my team released our first official campaign television ad. While we started in Detroit and Grand Rapids, it will be expanding to other media markets in the coming days. It’s a great ad and delivers the message I want Michiganders to know. Simply put, we’re moving fast and we have the results to prove it. Check it out here! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=042722]

Jocelyn

subject: Tough times
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Cheri Beasley for North Carolina
body:
Running for the U.S. Senate and having Donald Trump and National Republicans relentlessly attack me personally — that hasn’t been easy either.
#

[](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-kelly-split.ce-Laa&refcode=em220924-3-ma&refcode2=1818.357359.t4Uyfp&t=1&akid=1818%2E357359%2Et4Uyfp)

_Gabby and me during her recovery_
Friends -
When I think about the toughest times in my life, I’m thankful I’ve always had a support system to help me through.
Being raised by two working parents who sometimes struggled to make ends meet wasn’t always easy.
Flying combat missions in Desert Storm wasn’t easy.
Watching Gabby fight so hard in the early days, weeks, and months of her recovery wasn’t easy.
Running for the U.S. Senate and having Donald Trump and National Republicans relentlessly attack me personally — that hasn’t been easy either.
But as a kid, I had my brother Scott.
In combat, I had my wingmen.
With Gabby, we had our whole community offering support.
And in these campaigns, Cheri Beasley and I have you.
We could not do this without you. You probably didn't wake up this morning thinking you’d make a donation to our campaigns, but we really need you if we’re going to hold this seat and flip North Carolina’s seat.

clean_body: As a soldier, Alek was trained to take out a terrorist threat - As an American, he was taught to stand up for freedom no matter where I was in the wor We’re spending money like drunken sailors. Our individual liberties have been trounced and continue to be under constant threat from authoritarians running the show in D.C. and President Biden and VP Harris clearly do NOT have a grip on the power they wield. . | f Fellow Conservative, If I can't tell this story to voters in my district, I'm going to lose my race. It would be bad for not just Southwest Oregon, but for the country if I lost on November 8th. Becuase I think people have had enough of this one party leadership that's obviously taken us down the wrong path. It was Friday, August 21, 2015. I boarded train #9364 in Brussels, bound for Paris. My plans were simple and spirits were high. I was on vacation with my two best friends after completing a tour in Afghanistan as a U.S. soldier. But someone we didn’t expect boarded the train that day too, and he would change our lives forever. Ayoub El-Khazzani, an ISIS terrorist emerged from the bathroom, bare-chested and armed with a box cutter, an assault rifle, a jar of gasoline, and 270 rounds of ammunition attempted to take over and kill more than 500 passengers. And he would have succeeded, except he didn’t know three proud Americans were aboard and ready to fight like hell. I tapped my friend on the shoulder and said: ‘Let’s go.’ As a soldier, I was trained to take out a terrorist threat - As an American, I was taught to stand up for freedom no matter where I was in the world. Which is why I, my friends and other brave travelers took the action needed to stop this terrorist. But first, you need to understand why we need an American fighter like myself in Washington. Right now, our homeland is in danger. Not from radical Islamic terrorists, but radical Democrats who want to fundamentally alter the fabric of this GREAT nation. Leftist legislation is assaulting our Nation, our communities, and the American Dream. Right now, Democrats are... Opening and destroying our borders. They are granting dangerous amnesty that have and will continue to flood every corner of America. Raising our taxes like we have never seen, and making common goods like gas and groceries unaffordable. Indoctrinating the American people with their woke, Leftist ideology Teetering on the edge of dangerous foreign policy crises These power-hungry Democrat elitists like Nancy Pelosi and Joe Biden don’t care about the people they represent. They only care about their own radical agenda, and my opponent, Val Hoyle will be another one of their foot soldiers. The Biden Democrats' grip on power in Washington is seriously undermining our freedom, prosperity, and security. The only way to pull America out of this leftist tailspin is by taking back the House THIS November. My life’s mission has always been to represent the America I know and love - the world’s bastion of freedom and economic prosperity. This will not be an easy road, which is why I am reaching out to you. I will need the financial support of every American patriot; every single dollar will help. God Bless, Alek Skarlatos Alek Skarlatos Republican for Congress | Alek is a former Oregon National Guardsman, completing a nine-month deployment in Afghanistan. [1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Hi Derek, it’s
Stacey Abrams.

Early voting begins in just under 24 days here in Georgia. That means in
just 24 days, the first in-person ballot will be possibly cast in either
Brian Kemp’s name or mine.

So, I’m making calls. I’m making calls to tell my grassroots supporters
thank you and to listen to stories from people who donate to this
campaign.

before early voting starts, you might get a thank you call from me. Can
you donate $5 or any amount to ensure that we can turn out
as many of our supporters during Early Vote as possible and make sure
you’re on my call list?

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/3387?refcode=sa_em_220924_B3_SYACall_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=9448%2E1862389%2ESydYWV ]DONATE

We only have 24 days until my team’s Early Vote strategy is put to the
test.

We only have 24 days until our final sprint begins.

We can’t wait for Election Day,
Derek. Brian Kemp is counting

election, Early Vote is going to define our winning strategy. We’re going
to get as many Georgians as possible through the door and into a voting
booth before Brian Kemp’s voter suppression tactics can reach them.

A better Georgia is possible. A safer Georgia is possible.

call and thank you very soon.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/3387?refcode=sa_em_220924_B3_SYACall_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1005&akid=9448%2E1862389%2ESydYWV ]DONATE

Stacey

name: Grace Jo
subject: (List Inside) Is the Dissident Project coming to your town?
body:
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61389262:JwBZFaV7N:m:1:3253819041:35DCBD06C28EEF8458DD198CFC75A2ED:r)
Peter,

When you hear about North Korea, what comes to mind?

The news tells stories of socialism, dictatorship, military maneuvers, and food shortages. But few talk about what happens to the citizens. What happened to me. . .

My name is Grace Jo. I escaped North Korea and the horrors of Communism.

[_**Will you help me tell my story to students across the country? **_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61389262:JwBZFaV7N:m:1:3253819041:35DCBD06C28EEF8458DD198CFC75A2ED:r)

Too many young people believe the United States is an evil, oppressive country and that capitalism is a failure.

But they don't understand what an oppressive country really looks like.

Most Americans today don't understand what socialism does to you. How it steals your humanity - starves your soul, mind, and stomach of all that freedom provides.

Young Voice's latest program, Dissident Project, is countering the mainstream narratives about how peaceful and successful socialism can be. The Dissident Project brings survivors of tyrannical socialist countries, like me, to high schools around the United States to share our stories.

**I 'm excited to share that the Young Voices Dissident Project already has over 20 bookings! **

Now, we're looking to raise $10,000 this week to support our speakers as they head out to high schools across the country.

[_**Your generous gift helps Dissident Project speakers like me share our stories about the horrors of socialism with high school students. Click here to donate $25, $50, or any amount today >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61389262:JwBZFaV7N:m:1:3253819041:35DCBD06C28EEF8458DD198CFC75A2ED:r)

We've already started heading to classrooms across the country!

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61389262:JwBZFaV7N:m:1:3253819041:35DCBD06C28EEF8458DD198CFC75A2ED:r)

So far, we're going to cities like-
* Bayonne, NJ
* Brookfield, WI
* Chelsea, MA
* Cinco Ranch, TX
* Monroe, NC
* Rose Hill, KS
* Valdosta, GA
* Washington, D.C
* West Valley City, UT

And that list will continue to grow as the school year progresses. These schools are excited to give their students a rare opportunity to hear a first-hand account of what it's like to grow up in an oppressive state.

[_**Can I count on you to support a Dissident Speaker as we head out to these schools? Click here to send your urgent gift >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61389262:JwBZFaV7N:m:1:3253819041:35DCBD06C28EEF8458DD198CFC75A2ED:r)

The more similarities I see between North Korea and America, the more I'm convinced that students need to hear my story.

College students are self-censoring to avoid backlash over the tiniest things.

It reminds me of how in North Korea, everyone must censor themselves. But that's because anyone caught speaking out against the regime could be jailed or executed.

No one in the United States is getting executed, but people are still self-censoring out of fear that they will get kicked out of colleges and organizations or canceled by online mobs.

We have a chance **now** to turn America away from socialism.

But to do that, we need to educate the next generation on the true dangers of socialism.

Can I count on you to help me reach my goal of raising $10,000 this week to support Dissident Speakers? **Click below to send your gift.**

Nineteen miles to go, friend. We're in the final stretch.
As I'm writing you this email, I've been traveling from one rally to the next and just got back on the campaign bus. With only 45 days left before Election Day, I'm visiting every single corner of Florida – from the Panhandle to the Keys.

name: Grace Jo
subject: (List Inside) Is the Dissident Project coming to your town?
body:
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61389309:J-lZeaVqN:m:1:3331421248:EE7C40C033CE5A1E5793A6B9DFDA00A3:r)
Peter,

When you hear about North Korea, what comes to mind?

The news tells stories of socialism, dictatorship, military maneuvers, and food shortages. But few talk about what happens to the citizens. What happened to me. . .

My name is Grace Jo. I escaped North Korea and the horrors of Communism.

[_**Will you help me tell my story to students across the country? **_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61389309:J-lZeaVqN:m:1:3331421248:EE7C40C033CE5A1E5793A6B9DFDA00A3:r)

Too many young people believe the United States is an evil, oppressive country and that capitalism is a failure.

But they don't understand what an oppressive country really looks like.

Most Americans today don't understand what socialism does to you. How it steals your humanity - starves your soul, mind, and stomach of all that freedom provides.

Young Voice's latest program, Dissident Project, is countering the mainstream narratives about how peaceful and successful socialism can be. The Dissident Project brings survivors of tyrannical socialist countries, like me, to high schools around the United States to share our stories.

**I 'm excited to share that the Young Voices Dissident Project already has over 20 bookings! **

Now, we're looking to raise $10,000 this week to support our speakers as they head out to high schools across the country.

[_**Your generous gift helps Dissident Project speakers like me share our stories about the horrors of socialism with high school students. Click here to donate $25, $50, or any amount today >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61389309:J-lZeaVqN:m:1:3331421248:EE7C40C033CE5A1E5793A6B9DFDA00A3:r)

We've already started heading to classrooms across the country!

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61389309:J-lZeaVqN:m:1:3331421248:EE7C40C033CE5A1E5793A6B9DFDA00A3:r)

So far, we're going to cities like-
* Bayonne, NJ
* Brookfield, WI
* Chelsea, MA
* Cinco Ranch, TX
* Monroe, NC
* Rose Hill, KS
* Valdosta, GA
* Washington, D.C
* West Valley City, UT

And that list will continue to grow as the school year progresses. These schools are excited to give their students a rare opportunity to hear a first-hand account of what it's like to grow up in an oppressive state.

[_**Can I count on you to support a Dissident Speaker as we head out to these schools? Click here to send your urgent gift >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61389309:J-lZeaVqN:m:1:3331421248:EE7C40C033CE5A1E5793A6B9DFDA00A3:r)

The more similarities I see between North Korea and America, the more I'm convinced that students need to hear my story.

College students are self-censoring to avoid backlash over the tiniest things.

It reminds me of how in North Korea, everyone must censor themselves. But that's because anyone caught speaking out against the regime could be jailed or executed.

No one in the United States is getting executed, but people are still self-censoring out of fear that they will get kicked out of colleges and organizations or canceled by online mobs.

We have a chance **now** to turn America away from socialism.

But to do that, we need to educate the next generation on the true dangers of socialism.

Can I count on you to help me reach my goal of raising $10,000 this week to support Dissident Speakers? **Click below to send your gift.**

[_**Donate $25 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61389310:J-lZeaVqN:m:1:3331421248:EE7C40C033CE5A1E5793A6B9DFDA00A3:r)

[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61389312:J-lZeaVqN:m:1:3331421248:EE7C40C033CE5A1E5793A6B9DFDA00A3:r)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61389313:J-lZeaVqN:m:1:3331421248:EE7C40C033CE5A1E5793A6B9DFDA00A3:r)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61389314:J-lZeaVqN:m:1:3331421248:EE7C40C033CE5A1E5793A6B9DFDA00A3:r)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61389315:J-lZeaVqN:m:1:3331421248:EE7C40C033CE5A1E5793A6B9DFDA00A3:r)

I come from a state that ranks in the bottom five for almost everything: 46th in healthcare, 47th in infrastructure and the economy, 48th in education and opportunity, 49th in the environment, and 50th in crime. Louisiana is long overdue for a new vision and stronger leadership. That’s why I’m running for Senate. There are more of us struggling to make ends meet, traveling on crumbling roads and bridges in big cities and small towns in street traffic. Meanwhile, foot traffic to our small businesses dwindles. We can only win Senate control if we all work together. Thanks for sticking with me through thick and thin. There are too many of us having to choose between buying our medicines and paying our utility bill. Too many of us who face insurmountable student loan debts. Too many of us are dying from the pollution of chemical plants in our communities. Friend,

When I was growing up, my family didn't have a lot of money. My mom raised my sister and me in a small apartment, and she supported us by working as a hairdresser. After school, I'd work at her shop — sweeping the floor and washing hair. And I'd listen to women talk about their lives and their fears.

Today, women like the ones I grew up with are alarmed that far-right politicians are passing law after law to control women's bodies. They’re terrified that our Attorney General — Chris Carr — cares more about investigating miscarriages and putting doctors in jail than he does about protecting folks from crime and gun violence.

I'm thinking about these women from my childhood as Election Day approaches. I'm thinking about the women today sharing their fears with one another. I'm thinking about everyone who's felt unheard and struggled to get by. I'm thinking about everyone who is uncertain and concerned about what the future holds for our fundamental rights.

**But, we have a say in that future. Just 45 days from now, we have a chance to vote out anti-choice politicians like Chris Carr and give Georgians leaders who respect the right to privacy and the right to reproductive healthcare.**

The days are getting shorter but they’re not getting any easier,
folks.

If you’re anything like me, the closer we get to Election Day, the more
stress you’ll feel.

That’s why it’s so important we take a moment to unwind, find our sense of
calm, and allow ourselves the opportunity to be in the present—even when
the future seems so daunting.

We all know what’s at stake this November—abortion access, voting rights,
our nation’s economic success, and heck, even the future of democracy as
we know it.

But we can’t allow ourselves to become overwhelmed. Instead, each and
every one of us must focus on doing our individual part, one day at a
time, until we see the change we strive for.

For me, that means traveling around Ohio, having real, face-to-face
conversations with voters, and continuing to fight for working families.

I’m not sure what it looks like for you—we’re all different—but I hope at
the end of a long day, you allow yourself the space to unwind and focus on
what’s truly important.

And if you discover you’re ready to keep going and continue the fight,

Team,
Mark your calendars and get the popcorn ready... because Elissa’s first debate with her opponent airs this Sunday at 10am on Flashpoint (that's Channel 4 in Detroit).
This is the first of two televised debates Elissa challenged her opponent to in August, immediately following the primary. The second one will be on October 6th on Channel 6 (WLNS in Lansing).
They’re going to have quite a bit to discuss. As a refresher, Elissa’s opponent voted *five times* against a bipartisan deal in the state legislature that has created thousands of jobs in mid-Michigan. He’s also not only publicly bragged about his extreme “100%" anti-abortion position on the personal freedom of Michigan women, but then tried to hide his unpopular opinion by entirely scrubbing it from his website (only to republish it with an added attack on Elissa after being called out).
Ultimately, this first debate offers a chance to lay out the clear contrast between Elissa and her opponent to the voters of the new 7th district. Majewski, and the time to stop his attacks on America is now. There are just a few congressional races that'll determine if Democrats hold the House. These contests will decide the very future of our democracy. **[Can you please join me in giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to Marcy Kaptur to help us win this crucial toss-up race and hold Congress?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8a57ff64-f118-437f-b736-a8948c8a6c48/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** Do we keep passing bills like the Inflation Reduction Act, with which Democrats--and only Democrats--cut prescription prices in half by allowing Medicare to bulk negotiate their cost, or if we go down a dark path where Marjorie Taylor Greene gains control and does what she said she'll do, tries to eliminate Social Security, ban abortion nationwide and impeach President Biden & Vice-President Harris for [insert reason, it changes by the day]. We must hold onto our best Congress members and reject the very worst. No race is more emblematic of this than OH-9, where longtime progressive Democrat Marcy Kaptur--who fights everyday to protect choice, ban assault rifles & save our right to vote--is trying to fend off unstable-MAGA-ite Majewski, a Trump-endorsee.

subject: Screw it.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by UNITEDemocrats PAC
body:
| Peter, my team might not approve, but I’ll just say it: I’m getting a liiiiittle tired of asking for donations all the time.

BUT.

We have **less than 7 weeks** to ensure I defeat Dr. freakin’ Oz AND this race could literally make or break our Democratic Senate Majority.
